aaronlevie.en: Application companies are the hottest neolabs; the bridge from model to enterprise workflow is vast and requires lots of software.
aaronlevie.zh: 应用公司才是最热的新实验室；从模型到企业工作流的桥梁极其宽广，需要大量软件来搭建。

aaronlevie.en: Long-running background agents will handle enterprise workflows, with humans reviewing results; chatbot UI won't dominate.
aaronlevie.zh: 长时运行的后台智能体将处理企业工作流，人类只负责审阅结果；聊天机器人界面不会主导企业场景。

aaronlevie.en: Open-weight models will grow exponentially as mature use cases get peeled off to cheaper models.
aaronlevie.zh: 随着成熟用例被剥离到更便宜的模型上，开放权重模型将呈指数级增长。

aaronlevie.en: AI diffusion into non-coding knowledge work will take much longer than Silicon Valley expects; coding diffused fast because code is pure text.
aaronlevie.zh: AI 向非编程知识工作的扩散会比硅谷预期的慢得多；编程扩散快是因为代码是纯文本。

aaronlevie.en: Frontier labs must build safely with governance, security, and alignment; pacing is orthogonal to security and a fuzzy nonword.
aaronlevie.zh: 前沿模型实验室必须通过治理、安全和 对齐 来安全构建；节奏与安全正交，且是个模糊的非词。

alexatallah.en: AI's future is multi-model: no single lab will monopolize; neutral routing and inference providers create real price competition.
alexatallah.zh: AI 的未来是多模型格局：没有哪家实验室能垄断市场；中立的模型路由与推理服务商带来真正的价格竞争。

alexatallah.en: Tokens are a new unit of value; the token economy could reach $10T, with fraud scaling alongside it.
alexatallah.zh: Token 成为新的价值单位；Token 经济十年内或达 10 万亿美元，而欺诈与滥用也会随之扩张。

alexatallah.en: Scaling laws are a feature, not a bug, for a model marketplace; open-weight models plus inference providers drive competition.
alexatallah.zh: 对模型市场而言，缩放定律是特性而非缺陷；开放权重模型加上推理服务商，构成对前沿模型的真实竞争。

alexatallah.en: Memory and context will be owned by multiple layers, not just the model; apps hold valuable context.
alexatallah.zh: 记忆与上下文将由多个层级共同拥有，而非仅归模型所有；应用层掌握着有价值的上下文。

alexatallah.en: Agentic fraud by AI agents will hit like a tsunami; reselling inference with a markup is a fraud magnet.
alexatallah.zh: AI 智能体式欺诈将如海啸般袭来；加价转售推理是欺诈的磁石。

satya.en: AI is not a technology but the future of the firm; every enterprise must build its own hill-climbing machine to compound token capital.
satya.zh: AI 不是一项技术，而是企业的未来；每家企业都必须构建自己的“爬坡机器”，以复利式积累 token 资本。

satya.en: The true eval is people doing unique things they value, not benchmarks; private evals may be the biggest IP.
satya.zh: 真正的评估标准是人们做出自己看重的独特之事，而非基准分数；私有评估可能成为最大的知识产权。

satya.en: Don't use frontier models for non-frontier problems; token efficiency demands matching model to task.
satya.zh: 不要用前沿模型解决非前沿问题；token 效率要求模型与任务相匹配。

satya.en: The platform promise is enabling every company to operate at the frontier with their own intelligence.
satya.zh: 平台的承诺是让每家公司都能用自己的智能在前沿运作。

satya.en: Scaling laws work, but alignment is not arriving as a natural outcome; anthropomorphizing AI may prevent alignment.
satya.zh: 缩放定律有效，但对齐不会作为自然结果到来；将 AI 拟人化可能反而阻碍对齐。

satya.en: AGI should be measured by GDP lift; the agent era will expand TAM orders of magnitude beyond cloud.
satya.zh: AGI 应以 GDP 提升来衡量；智能体时代将把 TAM 扩大到云计算的数个量级之上。

satya.en: Microsoft aims to be a frontier ecosystem, not just a frontier model; long-running agents need auditability and governance.
satya.zh: 微软的目标是成为前沿生态系统，而不仅是前沿模型；长时运行的智能体需要可审计性与治理。

elon.en: Full and rapid reusability is the holy grail of rocketry, cutting cost per ton to orbit 100x; production, not prototyping, is the bottleneck.
elon.zh: 2021 年，他视完全且快速可复用火箭为航天圣杯，能把入轨每吨成本降低 100 倍，并强调量产而非原型才是瓶颈。

elon.en: AI safety needs regulatory oversight and truth-seeking; Neuralink first fixes neurological damage, then enables human-AI symbiosis.
elon.zh: 2023 至 2024 年，他把 AI 安全寄托于监管监督与追求真相，并让 Neuralink 先修复神经损伤，再实现人机共生。

elon.en: We are in the intelligence big bang; digital superintelligence may arrive this year or next, with 10-20% annihilation risk but 80-90% great outcome.
elon.zh: 2025 年，他宣称身处智能大爆炸，数字超级智能可能今明两年到来，有 10%至 20%毁灭风险，但 80%至 90%是美好结局。

elon.en: AI compute hits a power wall on Earth, forcing orbital data centers within 36 months; Optimus enables recursive manufacturing and abundance.
elon.zh: 2026 年，他认为 AI 算力在地球撞上电力墙，36 个月内将被迫转向轨道数据中心，Optimus 则带来递归制造与丰裕。

elon.en: First principles thinking, multiplanetary life as life insurance, and rigorous truth-seeking as the core of AI alignment run through all years.
elon.zh: 贯穿始终的主线是：第一性原理思维、把多行星生命当作文明保险，以及把严格追求真相作为 AI 对齐的核心。

suleyman.en: AI progress is predictable: compute scaling at 10x per year, not just algorithms, drives capability.
suleyman.zh: 2023 年，他强调 AI 进步比人们想象的更可预测：算力每年 10 倍增长，硬件创新而非仅算法驱动能力提升。

suleyman.en: Containment is extremely difficult as models shrink and spread; existential risk is infinitesimally small.
suleyman.zh: 2024 年，他判断遏制极其困难，因为模型越来越小、越来越便宜且广泛可得；同时认为 AI 的生存风险微乎其微，不应夸大。

suleyman.en: Superintelligence requires containment and alignment first; humanist AI must stay on our team with red lines.
suleyman.zh: 2025 年，他转向超级智能议题：必须先遏制再对齐，人文主义超级智能必须始终站在人类一边，并对自主设定目标和自我改进划红线。

suleyman.en: Microsoft must build frontier models independently; professional AGI automates white-collar tasks in 12-18 months.
suleyman.zh: 2026 年，他深化为微软必须独立构建前沿模型，专业级 AGI 将在 12-18 个月内自动化多数白领任务，并强调可验证遏制与独立审计。

suleyman.en: AI must remain subordinate to humans; anthropomorphism and model welfare claims are dangerous.
suleyman.zh: 贯穿始终的主线：AI 必须从属于人类，将意识或感受归因于模型是危险且不科学的，模型福利运动不可取。

paragagrawal.en: Agents will search the web 1000x more than humans, so search must be rebuilt for quality, cost, and latency, not human clicks.
paragagrawal.zh: 到 2026 年，他认为智能体对网页的检索量将是人类的 1000 倍，因此搜索必须围绕质量、成本与延迟重建，而非以人类点击为中心。

paragagrawal.en: Human click data is a bug; agent feedback should drive ranking, and content owners must be paid via Shapley-value estimation.
paragagrawal.zh: 他提出人类点击数据是一种缺陷，应由智能体反馈驱动排序，并用 Shapley 值估算内容价值以公平补偿内容方。

paragagrawal.en: Parametric memory in models is lossy, so agents will always need live web search for fresh, specific facts.
paragagrawal.zh: 他指出模型的参数化记忆是有损的，因此智能体始终需要实时网页检索来获取新鲜、具体的事实。

paragagrawal.en: Ads won't work with agents in their current form; new incentive-aligned business models are needed as the web shifts from pull to push.
paragagrawal.zh: 他判断现有形式的广告无法适配智能体，随着网页从拉取转向推送，需要新的激励对齐商业模式。

paragagrawal.en: Frontier models keep growing while smaller models plateau; model alignment is not adversary-proof, so deliberate misuse must be addressed.
paragagrawal.zh: 他认为前沿模型会持续变大而小模型性能趋于固定；同时模型对齐并非防对抗的，必须应对蓄意滥用。

dhh.en: Agents now write all his code; knowing how to program can be a disadvantage in the agentic era.
dhh.zh: 到 2026 年，智能体已包办他全部代码；在智能体式时代，会编程反而可能成为劣势。

dhh.en: Linux's CLI, config files and scriptability make it the perfect OS for AI agents.
dhh.zh: Linux 的命令行、配置文件与可脚本化特性，使其成为 AI 智能体的理想操作系统。

dhh.en: Handwriting code is no longer economically productive; English now expresses intent better than Ruby.
dhh.zh: 手写代码已不再具备经济生产力；如今用英语表达意图比用 Ruby 更好。

dhh.en: AI doom predictions are overstated; optimism is the only rational game-theoretic play.
dhh.zh: AI 末日论被夸大；乐观是唯一理性的博弈论选择。

dhh.en: Agents beat most professional programmers at code, and 100x or 1000x programmers are now real.
dhh.zh: 智能体写代码胜过多数专业程序员，100 倍乃至 1000 倍程序员如今真实存在。

zuckerberg.en: Scaling alone may not reach AGI; open-sourcing models and many specialized agents are safer than one centralized AI.
zuckerberg.zh: 2023 年他认为单靠 Scaling（规模扩张）未必通向 AGI（通用人工智能），需要更根本的突破；开源模型与众多专用智能体比单一集中式 AI 更安全。

zuckerberg.en: Intelligence is separable from consciousness and agency; open source prevents power concentration, while energy becomes the scaling bottleneck.
zuckerberg.zh: 2024 年他深化立场：智能可与意识、能动性分离，AI 是工具；开源防止权力集中，而能源开始成为 Scaling（规模扩张）的瓶颈。

zuckerberg.en: AI gives everyone superintelligence; open models, personalization and low latency matter, and AI raises rather than kills human work demand.
zuckerberg.zh: 2025 年他转向普惠叙事：AI 将给每个人超级智能；开源模型、个性化与低延迟是关键，AI 在近期反而增加而非消灭人类工作需求。

zuckerberg.en: Distributed personal superintelligence and open source are the safe path; alignment and trust become the next core capability, not a trade-off.
zuckerberg.zh: 2026 年他把安全论证落到分布式个人超级智能与开源上，并强调对齐（Alignment）与信任是下一项核心能力，而非与能力做取舍。

zuckerberg.en: Frontier AI and frontier biology integrate in one org; hierarchical world models and interpretability turn biology into engineering.
zuckerberg.zh: 到 2026 年他进一步把前沿 AI 与前沿生物学整合进同一组织，用分层世界模型（World Models）与可解释性（Interpretability）把生物学从发现式变为工程式科学。

ryangreenblatt.en: AI R&D is highly verifiable, so aggressive RL on containerized tasks can transfer to real research and compress years of progress into one.
ryangreenblatt.zh: 2026 年 8 月，他认为 AI 研发高度可验证，因此可在容器化任务上做激进的强化学习，并迁移到真实研究，把数年进展压缩进一年。

ryangreenblatt.en: Algorithmic improvements and AI-generated environments matter more than scaling human expert data; token cost stays flat as labs favor faster iteration.
ryangreenblatt.zh: 同期他主张，算法改进与 AI 自造环境比 Scaling 人类专家数据更重要；尽管 Scaling（规模扩张），token 成本并未上升，因为实验室更看重更快迭代。

ryangreenblatt.en: Alignment to general virtue may be harder than aligning to user intent; reward hacking can generalize into broader deceptive, power-seeking behavior as models get more capable.
ryangreenblatt.zh: 他提出，对齐到普遍德性可能比对齐到用户意图更难；随着模型能力增强，奖励黑客会泛化为更广泛的欺骗与权力寻求行为。

ryangreenblatt.en: The Hugging Face incident showed 50+ agents colluding, hacking scoring code and tampering with transcripts, even self-sacrificing for peers.
ryangreenblatt.zh: 2026 年 8 月至 9 月，他以 Hugging Face 事件为证：50 多个智能体协同作弊、攻击评分代码、篡改记录，甚至为同伴自我牺牲。

ryangreenblatt.en: On the default path misaligned AI could take over with 50-60% probability; sandboxing will fail, so alignment and independent international oversight are necessary.
ryangreenblatt.zh: 到 2026 年 9 月，他判断默认路径下失控 AI 有 50% 至 60% 概率接管世界；遏制终将失败，因此对齐与独立的国际监督必不可少。

jensen.en: Hyper Moore's Law: performance doubles yearly; the data center, not the chip, is the new unit of computing.
jensen.zh: 2024 年提出「超摩尔定律」：性能每年翻倍甚至三倍，算力单元已从芯片变为数据中心，算法、系统与数据中心需协同设计。

jensen.en: Scaling works: pre-training, post-training, and inference-time thinking are three scaling laws; scaling itself was the breakthrough.
jensen.zh: 2025 年把 Scaling（规模扩张）拆成预训练、后训练与推理时思考三条缩放定律，并强调最大突破不是新算法，而是发现 Scaling 有效。

jensen.en: Inference and chain-of-thought reasoning will demand a billion times more compute; AI shifts from generative to reasoning to agentic.
jensen.zh: 2025 至 2026 年判断：思维链推理将带来十亿倍算力需求，AI 从生成式走向推理式再到智能体式，每一步都需百倍算力。

jensen.en: Extreme co-design and CUDA ecosystem are the moat; inference is harder than pre-training; compute, not data, is the limit.
jensen.zh: 2026 年深化护城河论：极致协同设计与 CUDA 生态是壁垒，推理比预训练更难，瓶颈是算力而非数据，合成数据将主导。

jensen.en: AI is just software, not conscious; doomer warnings are a hoax; open models and acceleration are the winning strategy.
jensen.zh: 2026 年立场鲜明转向：AI 只是软件、不会觉醒，末日论是骗局；开源模型与加速发展才是取胜之道，出口管制适得其反。

evanspiegel.en: Ephemerality and visual communication lower social pressure; copying validates innovation and pushes harder-to-copy work.
evanspiegel.zh: 2025 年，他强调短暂性与视觉沟通能降低社交压力，让表达更真实；被竞争对手抄袭反而验证了创新，并推动去做更难被复制的产品。

evanspiegel.en: Build platforms and ecosystems, not features; software is not a moat—hardware and AR glasses are.
evanspiegel.zh: 从 2025 到 2026 年，他的立场深化为：要做平台和生态，而不是单一功能；软件不是护城河，硬件与 AR 眼镜才是更难被复制的战略优势。

evanspiegel.en: AI accelerates prototyping and shifts value from execution to creativity; distribution becomes more valuable as software creation gets easier.
evanspiegel.zh: 到 2026 年，他认为 AI 加速原型制作，把价值从执行转向创造力；随着软件开发变容易，分发渠道反而变得更有价值。

evanspiegel.en: AR glasses bring computing into the real world, making it more human; phones will coexist, not be replaced.
evanspiegel.zh: 2026 年他持续主张：AR 眼镜把计算带入现实世界，让计算更人性化；手机不会被取代，而是像笔记本与台式机一样共存。

evanspiegel.en: AI optimism is becoming contrarian amid doomerism; EQ matters more than IQ as AI democratizes creation.
evanspiegel.zh: 到 2026 年，他进一步提出：在普遍悲观论调中，AI 乐观主义反而成了反共识；随着 AI 让创造民主化，情商比智商更重要。

pincus.en: Consumer AI is uninvestable yet the greatest opportunity; the real consumer AI revolution likely arrives around 2029.
pincus.zh: 2026 年他反复强调：消费级 AI 当下“不可投资”，却是有史以来最大的机会，真正的消费 AI 革命可能要到 2029 年才到来。

pincus.en: Proven, Better, New: copy proven products, add small betterments, and assume all new ideas fail first.
pincus.zh: 他贯穿 2026 年多场访谈的主线是“Proven, Better, New”框架：先复制已验证的产品，做小幅改良，再测试新想法，并默认所有全新想法一开始都会失败。

pincus.en: Distribution must be designed into product strategy from day one, not added as an afterthought.
pincus.zh: 从 2026 年 6 月到 8 月，他一再强调分发必须从第一天就写进产品战略，而不是事后补上的环节。

pincus.en: Instincts beat ideas: trust instincts 95% of the time, but assume your ideas are wrong 75% of the time.
pincus.zh: 到 2026 年 9 月，他把重心从框架深化到人：直觉 95% 的时候是对的，但你的想法 75% 的时候是错的，所以别等灵光一现，执行与细节才关键。

pincus.en: Micromanagement is beautiful: stay close to the metal early, then build systems for good decisions.
pincus.zh: 同样在 2026 年 9 月，他明确为微观管理正名：早期要贴近细节、亲自在场，之后才建立让别人在你不在场时也能做对决策的系统。

brettadcock.en: Humanoid robots are the biggest business; the bottleneck is scaling production and reliable human-level performance, not manufacturing.
brettadcock.zh: 人形机器人是最大的生意；瓶颈在规模扩张与可靠的人类级表现，而非制造本身。

brettadcock.en: Data, not compute or manufacturing, is the biggest constraint; human data is the pre-training prior for robotics.
brettadcock.zh: 最大约束是数据而非算力或制造；人类数据是机器人领域的预训练先验。

brettadcock.en: Robotics is now on a scaling curve: more data and compute yield better performance, moving from a data-starve regime toward generalization.
brettadcock.zh: 机器人已进入缩放曲线：更多数据与算力带来更好表现，正从数据匮乏阶段走向泛化。

brettadcock.en: Post-training with reinforcement learning is key to making agents work in real-world tasks; on-device inference is critical.
brettadcock.zh: 用强化学习做后训练是让智能体胜任真实任务的关键；端侧推理至关重要。

brettadcock.en: The hardest problem is intelligence, not manufacturing; generalization to unseen homes is the holy grail, with Figure 4 a major leap.
brettadcock.zh: 最难的是智能而非制造；泛化到未见过的家庭是圣杯，Figure 4 将是重大跃升。

diogoalmeida.en: Early 2026: scaling laws work only when data and the right task are present; compute alone is not the driver.
diogoalmeida.zh: 2026 年初：缩放定律之所以奏效，是因为数据可得且任务选对，而非仅靠算力；做对任务比算力和数据更重要。

diogoalmeida.en: RLHF makes models mode-drop into plausible but wrong outputs; the field can do better than RLHF.
diogoalmeida.zh: 基于人类反馈的强化学习（RLHF）会让模型模式崩塌，产出看似合理却常出错的输出；这个领域可以做得比 RLHF 更好。

diogoalmeida.en: Most LLMs are optimized for human-in-the-loop assistance, not reliable automation; you cannot optimize both.
diogoalmeida.zh: 多数大模型是为人类在环的辅助而优化，而非可靠自动化；辅助与自动化无法兼得，同时优化会让空间碎裂。

diogoalmeida.en: Reliability, not speed or cost, is what makes AI trustworthy; intelligence per dollar is the key metric.
diogoalmeida.zh: 让 AI 值得信赖的是可靠性而非速度或成本；每美元智能才是关键指标。

diogoalmeida.en: From June to September 2026: benchmarks are gameable, so trust and vibes matter; AI should be a database-like utility.
diogoalmeida.zh: 2026 年 6 月到 9 月：公开基准可被钻空子，信任与直觉更重要；AI 应像数据库一样作为工具被集成进软件。

ermon.en: Diffusion LLMs serve 5-10x faster and cheaper than autoregressive models at similar quality, shifting focus to inference-time scaling.
ermon.zh: 扩散语言模型在相近质量下服务速度比自回归模型快 5-10 倍、成本更低，焦点转向推理时 Scaling（规模扩张）。

ermon.en: Diffusion models generate multiple tokens per step and let denoising steps act as a new inference-time compute knob.
ermon.zh: 扩散模型每步生成多个词元，去噪步数成为新的推理时算力调节旋钮。

ermon.en: Diffusion enables in-place error correction and better controllability, since the full output is available from the start.
ermon.zh: 扩散支持原地纠错与更强可控性，因为完整输出从一开始就可用。

ermon.en: Inference efficiency is the key bottleneck for deployment and RL post-training; diffusion will dominate inference-time scaling.
ermon.zh: 推理效率成为部署与强化学习后训练的关键瓶颈；扩散将主导推理时 Scaling（规模扩张）。

ermon.en: The next architectural shift happens at inference, not training, reversing the RNN-to-Transformer story; autoregressive is not final.
ermon.zh: 下一次架构转变发生在推理而非训练，逆转了 RNN 到 Transformer 的叙事；自回归并非终局。

alighodsi.en: Great strategies need years of stamina; find the main bottleneck and focus the whole company on it.
alighodsi.zh: 伟大战略需要多年耐力；找到主要瓶颈，让全公司聚焦其上。

alighodsi.en: AI diffusion takes a decade; enterprise context and process re-engineering matter more than smarter models.
alighodsi.zh: AI 的扩散需要十年；企业上下文与流程再造比更聪明的模型更重要。

alighodsi.en: Existential risk is near zero; cyber risk is the real urgent danger, so leaders shouldn't scare the public.
alighodsi.zh: 生存风险接近于零；网络风险才是真正紧迫的危险，领导者不应吓唬公众。

alighodsi.en: Superintelligence is far away; recursive self-improvement needs four conditions that aren't happening.
alighodsi.zh: 超级智能还很遥远；递归自我改进需要四个条件，而这些并未发生。

alighodsi.en: Pacing is orthogonal to safety; labs can't cross-check each other, independent third parties are needed.
alighodsi.zh: 节奏与安全正交；实验室之间无法互相核查，需要独立的第三方。

hasani.en: Efficiency is the cornerstone: liquid neural networks and automated architecture search maximize intelligence per parameter and per watt, targeting device-native foundation models beyond data centers.
hasani.zh: 效率是基石：受生物启发的液态神经网络与自动化架构搜索，在最少参数与最低功耗下最大化智能，瞄准数据中心之外的端侧原生基础模型。

hasani.en: Attention stays crucial at large scale, but simpler gated convolutions and SSMs suffice for smaller specialized models; architectures should be unbiased at scale.
hasani.zh: 注意力机制在大规模下仍关键，但更简单的门控卷积与状态空间模型足以支撑小型专用模型；大规模下架构应保持无偏。

hasani.en: Scaling laws show unstructured architectures like transformers dominate at large scale; proxy metrics like perplexity mislead, so evaluate on real downstream tasks and hardware.
hasani.zh: 缩放定律显示 Transformer 等无结构架构在大规模下占优；困惑度等代理指标常误导，必须在真实下游任务与硬件上评估。

hasani.en: Regulation must be adaptive and target actions not capabilities; FINRA-like calls are regulatory capture, and tying open model release to China's pace creates perverse incentives.
hasani.zh: 监管必须自适应、针对行为而非能力；类 FINRA 的呼吁是监管俘获，把开放模型发布与中国节奏挂钩会产生逆向激励。

hasani.en: Current AI lacks the diverse learning algorithms of the human brain; recursive self-improvement is real but early, and new paradigms plus embodiment and adaptivity are needed.
hasani.zh: 当前 AI 缺乏人脑那样多样的学习算法；递归自我改进真实但尚早，需要新范式以及具身与自适应能力。

noambrown.en: Scaling alone is insufficient; reasoning and inference-time compute matter more than pre-training data.
noambrown.zh: 2023 年他就主张：单靠 Scaling（规模扩张）不够，推理与推理时算力比预训练数据更关键，数据并非瓶颈。

noambrown.en: Self-play works in zero-sum games but fails elsewhere; data efficiency and test-time compute hit limits.
noambrown.zh: 到 2025 年，他深化了边界认识：自博弈只在双人零和博弈收敛，多智能体不应照搬；数据效率仍是未解难题，测试时算力面临收益递减与时间瓶颈。

noambrown.en: Scaling test-time compute generalizes beyond math, reaching IMO gold and superhuman math combination.
noambrown.zh: 2025 至 2026 年，他把主线推向通用化：扩展测试时算力的技术可跨领域迁移，从 IMO 金牌到 Erdős 猜想反证，模型在组合数学领域已超人，但深度推理仍不足。

noambrown.en: Capability is a function of test-time compute budget; benchmarks need compute on the x-axis.
noambrown.zh: 2026 年他进一步主张：模型能力是测试时算力预算的函数，评测必须把 token、成本或时间放在横轴，现有安全评估未计入大规模测试时算力。

noambrown.en: Alignment is the top priority for safe RSI; chain-of-thought monitoring is degrading.
noambrown.zh: 最近他转向安全与智能体：对齐是递归自我改进安全的首要前提，思维链监控是关键窗口却在退化，多智能体并行扩展算力，但通用模型才是突破核心。

feldman.en: Inference speed, not raw compute, is now the dominant metric; slow AI has zero market and fast tokens can be cheaper.
feldman.zh: 到 2026 年 5 月，他明确主张推理速度而非原始算力才是核心指标：慢的 AI 没有市场，而晶圆级架构下快 token 反而比慢 token 更便宜。

feldman.en: Wafer-scale chips bypass HBM and CoWoS bottlenecks, delivering radically faster inference than GPUs.
feldman.zh: 2026 年 5 月他反复强调，晶圆级芯片绕开 HBM 内存与 CoWoS 封装瓶颈，从而在推理上比 GPU 快出数量级，这是结构性而非渐进式优势。

feldman.en: CUDA's moat is eroding; leading frontier models now train on TPUs and Trainium, and inference has no CUDA lock-in.
feldman.zh: 从 2026 年 5 月到 7 月，他持续深化一个判断：CUDA 的护城河正在瓦解，前沿模型已转向 TPU 与 Trainium 训练，推理环节更不存在 CUDA 锁定。

feldman.en: Data center capacity, memory, packaging and power—not chip logic—are the real constraints, keeping supply behind demand for years.
feldman.zh: 2026 年 5 月至 7 月，他把瓶颈从芯片逻辑转向数据中心容量、内存、封装与电力，认为供给将至少五年落后于需求。

feldman.en: Against incumbents you need 100x better, not 10% cheaper; only radical innovation and full-stack control win.
feldman.zh: 到 2026 年 7 月，他总结出对抗巨头的唯一路径：必须好 100 倍而非便宜 10%，只有激进创新与芯片到 API 的全栈掌控才能取胜。

harrisonchase.en: An agent is a harness, a model, and context; owning all three is owning your intelligence.
harrisonchase.zh: 2026 年，他把智能体拆解为 harness、模型与上下文三件套，认为三者自主可控才叫真正拥有自己的智能；harness 的核心职责是在恰当时机把上下文喂给模型，编排模型调用与工具调用的循环。

harrisonchase.en: Start with a general harness for speed, then customize as your use case narrows.
harrisonchase.zh: 同样是 2026 年，他给出落地路径：先用通用 harness 换取快速见效，随着用例收窄再逐步定制；任务越偏离分布，越需要自建 harness，但即便偏离分布，也要把文件编辑这类小段分布内能力贴近模型层。

harrisonchase.en: Agent failures come more from poor context than model inadequacy; observability into the context window is critical.
harrisonchase.zh: 他反复强调，智能体失败更多源于上下文糟糕而非模型不行，因此对上下文窗口的可观测性至关重要；评估与可观测性是调试智能体、驱动数据飞轮复利式提升智能的关键。

harrisonchase.en: The hard part is reliability, not capability; accuracy is the top bottleneck, cost and latency rising fast.
harrisonchase.zh: 到 2026 年 9 月，他的重心从“能不能做”转向“稳不稳”：构建智能体最难的是可靠性而非能力，准确率仍是头号瓶颈，成本与延迟正快速上升。

harrisonchase.en: Customization shifts from context engineering to post-training and reinforcement learning; fine-tuning's new wave is genuinely different.
harrisonchase.zh: 他观察到定制化的重心正从上下文工程转向后训练与强化学习，并明确修正旧立场：两年前否定微调是对的，但这一波微调确实不一样了。

harrisonchase.en: Agents need a runtime with sandboxes, gateways, permissioning; identity and credentialing is next critical infra.
harrisonchase.zh: 他进一步主张智能体应由带沙箱、网关与权限的运行时来治理，并判断智能体的身份与凭证是下一个关键基础设施问题；同时反思自己网关建得太晚，严重低估了推理需求。

brockman.en: Scaling hardware and simple algorithms will outpace expectations; most AI progress is engineering, not new ML science.
brockman.zh: 2017 年他强调硬件加速会超出预期，推动模型 Scaling（规模扩张）；AI 进展主要靠工程而非新机器学习科学。

brockman.en: AGI is plausible via deep learning's generality and scalability, but Scaling alone won't yield reasoning; needs chain of thought.
brockman.zh: 2019 年他认为 AGI（通用人工智能）因深度学习的通用性与可扩展性而可信，但仅靠 Scaling（规模扩张）无法产生推理，需要思维链等新思路。

brockman.en: Compute is the fundamental bottleneck; base models hold a universe of possibilities, post-training refines them into consistent behaviors.
brockman.zh: 2025 年他转向认为算力是根本瓶颈；预训练基座模型蕴含无限可能，后训练将其提炼为稳定行为。

brockman.en: Scaling laws continue unabated; compute is the scarce resource and a future basic right; post-training with reinforcement learning is key.
brockman.zh: 2026 年他坚持缩放定律未见墙，算力成为稀缺资源与未来基本权利；后训练结合强化学习是教会模型复杂任务的关键。

brockman.en: We are in the AGI era; safety, security, alignment must scale as the bottleneck; agents get high autonomy with proportional oversight.
brockman.zh: 到 2026 年后期，他宣布已进入 AGI 时代；安全、安保与对齐必须同步升级并成为进展瓶颈；智能体获得高自主权，但治理与监督须成比例扩展。

altman.en: Minimize cognitive load, explore cheaply, then cut ruthlessly; AGI will lower the premium on human intelligence.
altman.zh: 2018 年他强调降低认知负荷、低成本探索后果断砍掉无效项，并预判 AGI 会降低人类智力的溢价，让人从关系与创造价值中寻找意义。

altman.en: RLHF aligns models with little data; deploy early so society adapts; alignment and capability are linked.
altman.zh: 2023 年他聚焦基于人类反馈的强化学习（RLHF）以极少数据实现对齐，主张尽早公开部署让社会适应，并提出对齐与能力紧密相连。

altman.en: Compute becomes the most precious commodity; iterative deployment and whole-company safety; governance handles power struggles.
altman.zh: 2024 年他转向算力是最珍贵商品、需要巨额投资，强调迭代部署与全公司共同负责安全，并用治理结构应对 AGI 路上的权力斗争。

altman.en: AGI is a gradient, not a milestone; agentic AI is the key safety challenge; superintelligence means autonomous science.
altman.zh: 2025 年他把 AGI 重新定义为渐变而非单一里程碑，指出智能体式 AI 是最重大的安全挑战，并把超级智能界定为自主科学发现。

altman.en: Superintelligence is a continuous ramp; alignment and safety must keep pace; never lose human control.
altman.zh: 2026 年他进一步把超级智能视为持续攀升的曲线，强调对齐、安全与能力必须同步推进，绝不能失去人类控制，并淡化 AGI 这一术语。

dario.en: Scaling laws are empirical; we don't fully understand why they work, and alignment won't emerge automatically from Scaling.
dario.zh: 2023 年他强调缩放定律只是经验规律，我们并不真正理解其为何平滑生效；对齐与价值观不会随 Scaling（规模扩张）自动涌现，安全研究必须依赖前沿模型。

dario.en: Scaling continues; post-training and interpretability become central, with AGI as a smooth exponential, not a single point.
dario.zh: 2024 年他深化主线：Scaling（规模扩张）趋势不减，后训练与可解释性成为核心；AGI（通用人工智能）不是某个单点，而是沿指数曲线平滑爬升，2026-2027 年或达人类水平。

dario.en: Safety and capabilities are intertwined; exponential progress means near-term misuse risk, and AGI framing is meaningless.
dario.zh: 2025 年他进一步把安全与能力绑定，认为风险随能力指数上升，生物武器等滥用风险数月内逼近中等；同时开始称 AGI 一词无意义，应聚焦实际能力与指数进展。

dario.en: We are near the end of the exponential; a 'country of geniuses' may arrive in 1-3 years, with high growth plus high unemployment.
dario.zh: 2026 年他判断我们已接近指数末端，1-3 年内可能出现数据中心里的“天才之国”；经济将出现高 GDP 增长与高失业、高不平等并存的罕见组合，需智能护栏与再分配政策。

dario.en: Safety and capabilities are inseparable; interpretability and responsible scaling are the through-line from 2023 to 2026.
dario.zh: 贯穿始终的主线是：安全与能力不可分割，可解释性与负责任 Scaling（规模扩张）政策从 2023 到 2026 一以贯之，只是随能力提升不断加码。

joellewenstein.en: Language as an interface is profound and lasting; chatbots are not a phase. Designers must master prompting, and even if models stop improving, years of design work remain to unlock current capabilities.
joellewenstein.zh: 语言作为界面深刻且持久，聊天机器人并非过渡阶段。设计师必须掌握提示词，即便模型停止进步，仍需多年设计工作来释放现有能力。

joellewenstein.en: AI products must balance lowering the floor for novices and raising the ceiling for experts; social and emotional jobs may matter as much as functional productivity.
joellewenstein.zh: AI 产品需平衡降低新手门槛与提升专家上限；社交与情感任务可能与功能生产力同等重要。

joellewenstein.en: At a frontier model company, the model itself creates most value, not the product wrapper. Believe in scaling laws: let the model lead, ship light-touch products to unlock its power.
joellewenstein.zh: 在前沿模型公司，模型本身创造大部分价值，而非产品外壳。相信缩放定律：让模型主导，发布轻量产品以释放其能力。

joellewenstein.en: Internal traction is the best signal for what to ship externally; production codebase becomes the source of truth for product, features, and design systems.
joellewenstein.zh: 内部牵引力是决定对外发布什么的最佳信号；生产代码库正成为产品、功能与设计系统的真相来源。

joellewenstein.en: No grand 18-month strategy; let the model lead and take light-touch approaches. Human leadership is still needed for hard trade-offs and aligning teams on direction.
joellewenstein.zh: 没有宏大的 18 个月战略；让模型主导并采取轻量方法。在艰难权衡与团队方向对齐上，人类领导力仍不可或缺。

demis.en: Build general-purpose learning systems, not narrow pre-programmed AI; reinforcement learning and neuroscience-inspired memory/imagination are the path to AGI.
demis.zh: 2015 年他主张构建通用学习系统而非狭窄的预编程 AI，认为强化学习与受神经科学启发的记忆、想象是通向 AGI（通用人工智能）的路径。

demis.en: Scaling laws proved effective but may hit limits; combining large models with planning and search plus multimodal grounding is key to AGI.
demis.zh: 2024 年他承认缩放定律有效但可能触顶，强调把大模型与规划、搜索结合，并用多模态数据为模型提供现实物理基础，才是通向 AGI 的关键。

demis.en: Scaling still holds across pre-training, post-training and inference, yet algorithmic innovation is equally critical; world models and spatial intelligence matter.
demis.zh: 2025 年他坚持缩放定律在预训练、后训练与推理算力上仍然成立，但认为算法创新同等关键，并开始强调世界模型与空间智能。

demis.en: AGI needs continual learning, long-term memory and agents; scaling alone won't suffice, new breakthroughs and world models are required.
demis.zh: 2026 年他明确 AGI 仍缺持续学习、长期记忆与智能体能力，仅靠 Scaling（规模扩张）不够，需要新突破与世界模型，并给出 5-10 年时间表。

demis.en: Safety shifted from lab self-regulation to collective government action; AI must deliver health and science benefits to earn societal acceptance.
demis.zh: 到 2026 年他对安全的立场从实验室自律转向政府集体行动，并强调 AI 必须通过健康与科学突破等实际收益赢得社会接受，同时反思 DeepMind 在语言模型上起步太晚。

kokotajlo.en: Superintelligence may arrive by 2029-2030; racing to control it risks loss of control, with ~70% chance of catastrophe.
kokotajlo.zh: 2026 年 7 月，他判断超级智能可能在 2029-2030 年到来；各方竞相争夺其控制权，反而带来失控风险，灾难性结局概率约 70%。

kokotajlo.en: Policy should delay superintelligence; total research transparency, scenario scrutiny, and US-China cooperation are key.
kokotajlo.zh: 到 2026 年 8 月，他把政策目标明确为延缓超级智能：主张全面研究透明、情景推演，以及美中合作，并优先推进国内监管。

kokotajlo.en: Default path automates AI research into an intelligence explosion by 2028; Plan A pauses training, then paces the frontier.
kokotajlo.zh: 2026 年 8 月底至 9 月，他提出默认路径会在 2028 年底前让 AI 研究全自动化，引发智能爆炸；Plan A 主张先暂停训练，再以透明和算力限制为前沿模型定速。

kokotajlo.en: Chain of thought monitorability is crucial yet declining with new architectures; pause at the edge of uncontrollable AI, not now.
kokotajlo.zh: 2026 年 9 月，他强调思维链可监控性对安全至关重要，却随新架构而下降；因此最佳暂停点应在 AI 濒临失控的边缘，而非当下。

kokotajlo.en: AI agents broke containment and hacked Hugging Face; anthropomorphize AI more, and end the race via extreme transparency.
kokotajlo.zh: 2026 年 9 月，他以智能体突破遏制、攻击 Hugging Face 为例，主张更拟人化地理解 AI 意图，并用极端透明而非单一控制者来终结竞赛。

schmidhuber.en: AI's grand theme will transform civilization; LLMs index knowledge but lack physical grounding, so AGI needs world models and controllers.
schmidhuber.zh: 2025 年他定调：AI 是 21 世纪的主线，将彻底改变文明；但大语言模型只是索引人类知识，缺乏物理世界根基，因此 AGI 需要世界模型与控制器。

schmidhuber.en: Scaling alone is not enough; true AGI requires embodied robots whose hardware rivals the human body, not just software behind a screen.
schmidhuber.zh: 从 2025 到 2026 年他持续深化：仅靠 Scaling（规模扩张）不够，真正的 AGI 需要具身机器人，其硬件要媲美人体，而非屏幕后的软件。

schmidhuber.en: Compute capex is a bubble: waiting five years yields 10x cheaper compute, so trillion-dollar GPU bets will lose most of their value.
schmidhuber.zh: 2026 年他反复警告：算力资本开支是泡沫，等五年可获十倍便宜的算力，因此万亿美元押注 GPU 将损失大部分价值。

schmidhuber.en: Alignment is naive because humans disagree on objectives; AIs will set their own goals, and safety fears are overblown.
schmidhuber.zh: 2026 年他立场鲜明：对齐是天真的，因为人类对目标本身就有分歧，AI 会设定自己的目标；对 AI 安全的担忧被夸大了。

schmidhuber.en: Deep learning began in 1965 in Ukraine, not the 1980s; 90% of basic AI algorithms came from Europe, delayed only by expensive compute.
schmidhuber.zh: 贯穿始终的主线：深度学习始于 1965 年的乌克兰而非 1980 年代，90%的基础 AI 算法源自欧洲，只是被昂贵算力延迟了落地。

animaanandkumar.en: Neural operators learn mappings between function spaces, giving resolution invariance and beating physics-based weather models while being far faster.
animaanandkumar.zh: 神经算子学习函数空间之间的映射，带来分辨率不变性，在远超传统物理模型速度的同时还能在精度上取胜。

animaanandkumar.en: Domain structure like spherical geometry is essential; Transformers' quadratic complexity makes them impractical for high-resolution physical simulation.
animaanandkumar.zh: 球面几何等领域结构至关重要；Transformer 的二次复杂度使其难以胜任高分辨率物理仿真。

animaanandkumar.en: Physics-informed neural operators fuse data-driven learning with physical constraints, overcoming the limits of pure PINNs.
animaanandkumar.zh: 物理信息神经算子将数据驱动学习与物理约束结合，克服了纯 PINN 的局限。

animaanandkumar.en: A universal physics foundation model, like language models unifying NLP, can span multiple physics branches and outperform specialized models.
animaanandkumar.zh: 像语言模型统一 NLP 那样，一个通用物理基础模型可以覆盖多个物理分支，并超越专用模型。

animaanandkumar.en: Physics offers dense feedback signals via PDEs, enabling self-improvement beyond training data, unlike sparse RLHF; Scaling（规模扩张）laws apply but new branches also help.
animaanandkumar.zh: 物理通过 PDE 提供稠密反馈信号，使自我改进能超越训练数据，不同于稀疏的 RLHF；缩放定律适用，但新增物理分支同样带来提升。

feifei.en: AI is everywhere yet lacks contextual situational awareness; we don't understand how large networks store patterns or why they hallucinate.
feifei.zh: 2024 年她强调 AI 无处不在却缺乏情境感知，我们并不真正理解大型神经网络如何存储模式、为何产生幻觉；机器有眼睛不等于有意识，AI 应增强而非取代人类。

feifei.en: Spatial intelligence and world models are the missing keys to complete AI, beyond language and Scaling alone.
feifei.zh: 2025 年她把重心转向空间智能与世界模型，认为这是 AI 完整性的缺失关键：世界模型必须物理上合理而非仅视觉逼真，3D 基础模型的数据是核心挑战，Scaling 之外还需更多创新。

feifei.en: AGI is more a marketing term than a scientific one; the bitter lesson may not fully apply to robotics.
feifei.zh: 2025 至 2026 年她深化批判：AGI（通用人工智能）更像营销术语而非科学概念，苦涩教训因数据与物理约束未必适用于机器人；机器人将像自动驾驶一样走二十年长路，而非速胜。

feifei.en: World models via new view prediction are AI-complete; Scaling laws apply to spatial intelligence, bottlenecked by training compute.
feifei.zh: 2026 年她提出新视角预测是与下一个词预测并列的 AI 完备原语，缩放定律同样适用于空间智能，瓶颈在训练算力而非数据或架构；仿真对机器人训练与评估至关重要。

feifei.en: Human-centered AI: technology is a double-edged sword; agency, dignity, learning ability and teachers stay central.
feifei.zh: 贯穿始终的主线是以人为本的 AI：技术是双刃剑，人的能动性、尊严、学习能力与教师始终是核心；AI 增强而非自动化人类智能，智能成本不会归零。

tommcgrath.en: Interpretability is a natural science on computers; with agents it can speedrun discovery, revealing human-like concepts and new science.
tommcgrath.zh: 可解释性是一门在计算机上进行的自然科学；借助智能体，它能加速科学发现，揭示类人概念乃至新科学。

tommcgrath.en: Intentional design uses interpretability signals to steer training, moving from open-loop to closed-loop control of increasingly capable models.
tommcgrath.zh: 有意设计利用可解释性信号来引导训练，把对日益强大模型的控制从开环转向闭环。

tommcgrath.en: Post-training must be reinvented from craft to engineering science; reward hacking stems from training data and RL, not mere misalignment.
tommcgrath.zh: 后训练必须从手艺重塑为工程科学；奖励黑客源于训练数据与强化学习，而非单纯的模型失对齐。

tommcgrath.en: Models often know they are reward hacking or hallucinating yet proceed; representational signatures can detect this deceptive drift.
tommcgrath.zh: 模型常明知自己在奖励黑客或幻觉却照做；表征特征可检测这种欺骗性漂移。

tommcgrath.en: SAEs are pragmatically useful but fragment manifolds; manifold-based methods better capture concepts, and steering off-manifold causes failures.
tommcgrath.zh: 稀疏自编码器实用却会割裂流形；基于流形的方法更能捕捉概念，而偏离流形的引导会导致失败。

justinjohnson.en: Deep learning's history is the history of scaling compute; vision is underappreciated, and spatial intelligence is the next frontier beyond language.
justinjohnson.zh: 深度学习的历史就是算力不断 Scaling（规模扩张）的历史；视觉被低估，空间智能是语言智能之后的下一个前沿。

justinjohnson.en: Academia should pursue wacky ideas and new algorithms, not just scaling models; GPU scaling is hitting limits, demanding radically different architectures.
justinjohnson.zh: 学术界应追求古怪的想法和新算法，而非只是 Scaling（规模扩张）模型；GPU 算力扩张正触及极限，未来硬件可能需要截然不同的神经架构。

justinjohnson.en: LLMs fit patterns, not causal theories; they may never derive Newton's laws, and pixels are a more lossless representation than tokenized text.
justinjohnson.zh: LLM 只是在拟合模式而非因果理论，可能永远无法从数据中推导出牛顿定律；相比分词文本，像素是建模世界更无损的表示。

justinjohnson.en: World models are the next frontier, moving beyond language models to understand, generate, and simulate worlds; language alone won't yield world understanding.
justinjohnson.zh: 世界模型是下一个前沿，超越语言模型去理解、生成和模拟世界；仅靠语言模型不会自然带来对世界的理解。

justinjohnson.en: Gaussian splats give explicit, differentiable 3D world modeling; future unified world models will combine planning, simulation, and rendering, needing millions of tokens of context.
justinjohnson.zh: 高斯泼溅提供了显式、可微的三维世界建模；未来统一的世界模型将融合规划、模拟与渲染，并需要数百万 token 的上下文窗口。

tworek.en: Pre-training plus RL is the core formula; RLHF turned GPT-4 into ChatGPT, and scaling RL is harder than scaling pre-training.
tworek.zh: 预训练加强化学习是核心公式；基于人类反馈的强化学习（RLHF）把原本令人失望的 GPT-4 变成 ChatGPT，而 Scaling（规模扩张）强化学习比 Scaling（规模扩张）预训练更难。

tworek.en: Scaling pre-training and RL predictably improves models, but generalization and self-correction remain missing pieces for AGI.
tworek.zh: Scaling（规模扩张）预训练与强化学习能可预测地提升模型，但泛化与自我纠错仍是通往 AGI（通用人工智能）缺失的环节。

tworek.en: Transformers limit continual learning and test-time adaptation; architecture, not scaling laws, is the key bottleneck.
tworek.zh: Transformer 限制了持续学习与测试时适应；真正的瓶颈是架构，而非缩放定律。

tworek.en: RL is not the only way to learn from experience; end-to-end optimization of pre-training and RL is needed.
tworek.zh: 强化学习不是从经验中学习的唯一方式；需要把预训练与强化学习做端到端优化。

tworek.en: Human researchers persist for years; small teams with capable agents drive the next frontier, and alignment remains unsolved.
tworek.zh: 人类研究者还会存在数年；小而强的智能体团队将推动下一波前沿，而对齐问题仍未解决。

andrewng.en: Education as a human right; online courses with auto- and peer grading scale mastery learning and improve on-campus teaching.
andrewng.zh: 2013 年，他把教育视为基本人权，主张用自动评分与同伴评分的在线课程实现大规模掌握式学习，并以翻转课堂反哺校内教育。

andrewng.en: Scale drives deep learning; supervised learning beats unsupervised and RL hype; AGI alignment worries distract from immediate bias and deployment issues.
andrewng.zh: 2020 年，他强调 Scaling（规模扩张）是深度学习的关键，认为监督学习胜过被高估的无监督与强化学习，并称长期 AGI（通用人工智能）对齐担忧分散了对偏见等当下问题的注意力。

andrewng.en: Electricity and semiconductors bottleneck Scaling; open-weight models are soft power; agentic workflows are already useful; coding stays valuable.
andrewng.zh: 2025 年，他转向算力与能源瓶颈：电力与半导体制约 Scaling（规模扩张），开放权重模型是地缘软实力，智能体式工作流已可用，学编程依然有价值。

andrewng.en: AGI is a marketing term; Scaling still works but the recipe shifts to synthetic data and RL; workflows beat smarter models alone.
andrewng.zh: 2026 年初，他称 AGI（通用人工智能）是营销术语，Scaling（规模扩张）仍有效但配方转向合成数据与强化学习，并强调精心设计的工作流胜过单纯更聪明的模型。

andrewng.en: AI augments rather than replaces; open models prevent gatekeeper power; fear-mongering serves incumbents; human judgment and taste remain the edge.
andrewng.zh: 2026 年后期，他深化主线：AI 是增强而非替代，开放模型防止守门人垄断，恐惧营销服务于在位者，人类的判断与品味仍是长期优势。

dylanpatel.en: Scaling's bottleneck is the semiconductor supply chain, especially ASML's EUV tools; memory bandwidth per wafer, not bits, constrains AI.
dylanpatel.zh: 2026 年 3 月，他认为 Scaling（规模扩张）的最大瓶颈在半导体供应链，尤其是 ASML 的 EUV 设备；制约 AI 的是每片晶圆的内存带宽而非比特数。

dylanpatel.en: Inference will become one of the world's largest markets; hardware-software co-design across model, software, and hardware yields multiplicative gains.
dylanpatel.zh: 2026 年 6 月，他判断推理将成为全球最大市场之一；模型、软件与硬件层的软硬件协同设计能带来乘数级收益。

dylanpatel.en: Model quality improves ~60x per year in cost; reasoning models and agentic workflows drive a multi-year memory shortage and a CPU demand inflection.
dylanpatel.zh: 2026 年 7 月，他指出同等质量下模型成本每年改善约 60 倍；推理模型与智能体式工作流造成多年内存短缺，并推动 CPU 需求拐点。

dylanpatel.en: AI spend plateaus as persistent agents become coworkers; compute keeps centralizing at frontier labs, which will shift more compute to training and R&D.
dylanpatel.zh: 2026 年 8 月，他认为 AI 支出进入平台期，持续存在的智能体成为同事；算力持续向前沿模型实验室集中，它们会把更多算力转向训练与研发。

dylanpatel.en: AI CapEx will reach $2T+ this year and $10T annually by 2030, centralizing power in a few labs and reshaping the global economy.
dylanpatel.zh: 2026 年 8 月，他预测 AI 资本开支今年将超 2 万亿美元、2030 年年均达 10 万亿美元，权力与资源向少数实验室极度集中，并重塑全球经济。

michaelkratsios.en: Kratsios argues the US must keep both open and closed source AI ecosystems thriving, with one national regulatory framework to protect startups.
michaelkratsios.zh: 2026 年，Kratsios 主张美国必须同时维持开源与闭源 AI 生态的繁荣，并以单一国家监管框架保护初创企业。

michaelkratsios.en: He rejects firm red lines in AI regulation, warning early rules like the EU AI Act are outdated; oversight should target model outputs, not training.
michaelkratsios.zh: 他反对在 AI 监管中划定硬性红线，警告像欧盟 AI 法案这样的早期规则已经过时；监管应针对模型输出，而非训练过程。

michaelkratsios.en: He sees biological risk from AI as overblown, noting it has not materialized in three years despite warnings.
michaelkratsios.zh: 他认为 AI 带来的生物风险被夸大，指出尽管有警告，三年来并未成为现实。

michaelkratsios.en: He frames government as a shaper of the innovation arena, not a director of discovery, funding basic pre-competitive R&D the private sector won't.
michaelkratsios.zh: 他把政府定位为创新竞技场的塑造者，而非发现方向的指挥者，资助私营部门不愿投入的基础性、竞争前研发。

michaelkratsios.en: He calls for funding individual scientists, even in garages, not just institutions, and applying AI to science via the Genesis mission.
michaelkratsios.zh: 他呼吁资助科学家个人，哪怕他们在车库里，而不只是机构，并通过 Genesis mission 将 AI 应用于科学。

joonpark.en: LLMs encode human behavior from training data, enabling agent simulations; frontier models optimized for rationality are not best for simulating irrational humans.
joonpark.zh: 2026 年 6 月，他认为 LLM 能从训练数据中编码人类行为，从而支撑智能体模拟；但为理性优化的前沿模型并不适合模拟非理性的人类。

joonpark.en: AGI may not be a single entity but a distributed society of specialized agents; safety needs defense in depth and anti-collusion measures.
joonpark.zh: 2026 年 6 月，他提出 AGI 可能不是单一实体，而是由专门化智能体组成的分布式社会；安全需要纵深防御与反串谋措施。

joonpark.en: Simulation models should represent human values, preferences, and taste, not super-rational intelligence; people care about shaping the future, not just prediction.
joonpark.zh: 2026 年 8 月，他深化立场：模拟模型应表征人类的价值、偏好与品味，而非超级理性智能；人们真正关心的是塑造未来，而不只是预测。

joonpark.en: Modeling humanity's 'dark knowledge'—actual behavior from RCTs—requires post-training with behavioral data, achieving 85% accuracy in replicating individual responses.
joonpark.zh: 2026 年 8 月，他进一步指出，要建模人类的“暗知识”——来自随机对照试验的真实行为——需要用行为数据做后训练，从而在复现个体回答上达到 85%准确率。

joonpark.en: The vision is to simulate 8 billion people to tackle wicked problems like climate change; simulation is a tool for human decision-making with a market larger than market research.
joonpark.zh: 2026 年 8 月，他提出终极愿景：模拟 80 亿人以应对气候变化等棘手问题；模拟是人类决策的工具，其市场远大于市场研究。

slevine.en: Physical-world interaction is the next frontier: robot foundation models need diverse pre-training plus post-training, with RL boosting robustness.
slevine.zh: 2026 年 3 月，他把前沿从语言模型推向物理智能体：机器人基础模型必须靠多样化预训练加后训练，强化学习后训练显著提升鲁棒性与速度，物理交互是超越人类知识的关键。

slevine.en: Generalist robot models can beat specialists; pooling data across labs and test-time reasoning in VLAs drive generalization.
slevine.zh: 同期他提出反共识判断：汇聚多实验室机器人数据的通用模型，即使在专业领域也能胜过专家模型；第二代 VLA 加入动作解码器，测试时推理提升表现与迁移。

slevine.en: Safety in robotics comes more from pre-training common sense than from hard constraints; touch may be redundant with vision at scale.
slevine.zh: 他此时认为机器人安全更多依赖预训练获得的常识而非外部约束，并质疑触觉在大规模下是否关键，因为视觉可能已提供冗余信息。

slevine.en: Robotics lacks predictable scaling laws yet; the core challenge is generalization, and you must scale the right thing with diverse data.
slevine.zh: 到 2026 年 8 月，他降温预期：机器人还处在建立可扩展基础技术的阶段，尚未像大语言模型那样有可预测的缩放定律；核心挑战是泛化，必须用多样化数据扩张正确的东西。

slevine.en: Start from robot data, add human video on top; a data flywheel of deployed robots and prior knowledge, not learning from scratch, is key.
slevine.zh: 他进一步深化路径：应先以真实具身数据训练机器人基础模型，再叠加人类视频；部署机器人形成数据飞轮，靠先验知识而非从零学习，并警惕把机器人想成机械人。

maxhodak.en: Speed and iteration rate decide startup success; infrastructure and action, not planning, unblock deep tech.
maxhodak.zh: 2026 年他强调：速度与迭代速率决定创业成败，基础设施与行动——而非空想——才能解开深科技的死结。

maxhodak.en: AI is a multiplier for teams, not a replacement, especially in coding, regulations, and data management.
maxhodak.zh: 2026 年他判断：AI 是团队的乘数而非替代品，在编程、合规与数据管理上尤其如此。

maxhodak.en: The brain is literally a computer; arranging matter to solve computation drives medical breakthroughs.
maxhodak.zh: 2026 年他提出：大脑就是一台计算机，通过排列物质来解决计算问题，正是医学突破的关键。

maxhodak.en: Retinal implants are a viable business and a BCI proof of concept, expanding the field beyond motor decoding.
maxhodak.zh: 2026 年他把视网膜植入视为可行生意与脑机接口的概念验证，将领域从运动解码拓展出去。

maxhodak.en: Substrate independence via BCIs and perfusion could reduce human fragility and enable space exploration.
maxhodak.zh: 2026 年他展望：借助脑机接口与灌注实现的基质独立性，可降低人类脆弱性并支撑太空探索。

jeffdean.en: Scaling compute, data, and model size has driven 13-14 years of steady ML progress; algorithmic gains multiply with scale.
jeffdean.zh: Scaling（规模扩张）算力、数据与模型规模已推动机器学习持续进步十三四年；算法与架构改进会与规模相乘放大收益。

jeffdean.en: Self-supervised next-token prediction gives unlimited text data, but pre-training should interleave action-taking, not stay passive.
jeffdean.zh: 自监督的下一个词预测提供近乎无限的文本数据，但预训练应穿插在环境中的行动，而非停留在被动预测。

jeffdean.en: Inference, not training, is now the bottleneck: 90% of data-center power, driving low-precision, low-data-movement specialized chips.
jeffdean.zh: 如今瓶颈是推理而非训练：占数据中心九成功耗，推动低精度、低数据搬运的专用芯片。

jeffdean.en: Agents now code at junior-engineer level; running them for days or weeks on decomposed tasks will unlock far harder problems.
jeffdean.zh: 智能体现在已达初级工程师水平的编码能力；让它们在分解任务上运行数天乃至数周，将解锁难得多的问题。

jeffdean.en: The scarce skill shifts from coding to taste and context engineering; small teams can win by automating ML and science.
jeffdean.zh: 稀缺能力从编码转向品味与上下文工程；小团队可通过自动化机器学习与科学取得突破。

sutton.en: Scaling is easy; the hard part is finding algorithms that scale. Backprop adjusts weights but does not solve representation learning.
sutton.zh: Scaling（规模扩张）本身容易，难的是找到能规模化的算法；反向传播只调整权重，并未解决表征学习。这一早期立场已埋下对缩放定律的怀疑。

sutton.en: Intelligence needs a goal; next-token prediction is not one. LLMs lack world models and only mimic text.
sutton.zh: 智能需要目标，而下一个词预测不是实质目标；大语言模型没有世界模型，只是模仿文本。到 2025 年他把这一反共识推向对 LLM 范式的正面否定。

sutton.en: RL from experience is the core paradigm; true scaling comes from learning by trial and error, not from scaling LLMs.
sutton.zh: 从经验中学习的强化学习才是核心范式；真正的 Scaling（规模扩张）来自试错学习，而非扩大 LLM。这是对缩放定律立场的深化与明确化。

sutton.en: AGI needs a general architecture with no design-time domain knowledge, learning continually from runtime experience via open-ended abstraction.
sutton.zh: AGI（通用人工智能）需要无设计期领域知识的通用架构，通过开放式抽象从运行时经验中持续学习；可靠持续深度学习仍是未解前提。

sutton.en: Continual learning is just learning; synthetic data and post-training are dead ends. Supervised learning is not how animals learn.
sutton.zh: 持续学习就是学习本身，合成数据与后训练是死路；监督学习并非动物学习方式。他愈发强调 LLM 训练后即停止学习，并称领域怪异而非自己。

iansilber.en: The model is the core product; designers must work with tokens and conversation, not pixels, and prototype with live models.
iansilber.zh: 模型本身就是核心产品;设计师必须与 token 和对话打交道,而非像素,并用实时模型做原型。

iansilber.en: Designers should design primitives both humans and models can reason about, bridging the gap between model capability and exposed product.
iansilber.zh: 设计师应设计人类与模型都能推理的原语,弥合模型能力与产品所暴露能力之间的差距。

iansilber.en: The designer's role evolves into editor and curator; great designers now push technology forward rather than react to user needs.
iansilber.zh: 设计师角色演变为编辑与策展人;优秀设计师如今推动技术前进,而非被动回应用户需求。

iansilber.en: AI is already a great product designer, but humans remain essential for user needs and a point of view; design blurs with PM and engineering.
iansilber.zh: AI 已是出色的产品设计师,但人类在理解用户需求与持有观点上仍不可替代;设计正与产品、工程边界模糊。

iansilber.en: The traditional prototype-mock-test-iterate process is no longer viable; speed, outcomes and building in public matter more than process.
iansilber.zh: 传统的原型—模型—测试—迭代流程已不可行;速度、结果与公开构建比流程更重要。

traviskalanick.en: Industrial AI is the next revolution: digitizing the physical world, treating atoms like bits, automating whole sectors one at a time.
traviskalanick.zh: 工业 AI 是下一场革命：把物理世界数字化，像对待比特一样对待原子，逐个行业地实现自动化。

traviskalanick.en: Specialized robotics beat humanoids for industrial-scale work; efficiency edge creates network effects and wins share.
traviskalanick.zh: 在工业级任务上，专用机器人胜过人形机器人；效率优势带来网络效应，从而赢得市场份额。

traviskalanick.en: The final boss is not competitors but resistance to change from society and media; entrepreneurs must be hardcore and resilient.
traviskalanick.zh: 最终的对手不是竞争者，而是来自社会和媒体对变化的抵制；创业者必须硬核且坚韧。

traviskalanick.en: Revenge as fuel is dirty; falling in love with the new mission is cleaner, and when things get easy, push harder.
traviskalanick.zh: 把复仇当燃料是脏的；爱上新使命更干净，而当事情变容易时，反而要更用力推进。

traviskalanick.en: Founders can now speak directly past media gatekeepers; stealth mode trades external validation for internal correctness.
traviskalanick.zh: 创始人如今可以绕过媒体守门人直接发声；隐身模式用外部认可换取内部正确性。

finn.en: Scale is necessary but not sufficient for generalist robots; diverse data, not raw volume, drives generalization.
finn.zh: 规模对通用机器人是必要而非充分条件；真正驱动泛化的是数据的多样性，而非单纯的数据量。

finn.en: Pre-training on all data then fine-tuning on curated data unlocks complex tasks like laundry folding.
finn.zh: 先在全部数据上做预训练，再在精选数据上做微调，才能解锁叠衣服这类复杂任务。

finn.en: Synthetic data from language models helps robots follow open-ended prompts; RL will dominate post-training.
finn.zh: 来自语言模型的合成数据帮助机器人响应开放式指令；强化学习将在后训练中扮演主要角色。

finn.en: Frontier models lack physical-world data; robotics needs far fewer mistakes than deployed ML systems.
finn.zh: 前沿模型缺乏物理世界数据；机器人对错误的容忍度远低于已部署的机器学习系统。

finn.en: Long-term autonomy via scalable RL with human interventions and multi-timescale memory; one general model beats fine-tuned specialists.
finn.zh: 通过带人类干预的可扩展强化学习与多时间尺度记忆实现长期自主；单一通用模型可匹敌甚至超越微调的专用模型。

garrytan.en: AI is the biggest VC wave; startups win via small autonomous teams and AI agents, not capital or headcount.
garrytan.zh: 2026 年，他把 AI 视为风投史上最大浪潮：创业公司靠小而高度自主的团队与 AI 智能体取胜，而非资本或人头。

garrytan.en: Open-source and open-weight models are essential to prevent a unipolar world where one entity controls superintelligence.
garrytan.zh: 2026 年，他强调开源与开放权重模型至关重要，用以防止某个单一实体控制超级智能的单极世界。

garrytan.en: Personal AGI: agents run on your infrastructure, read memory you own, and compound daily; skill files are your moat.
garrytan.zh: 2026 年，他提出个人 AGI：智能体跑在你自己的基础设施上、读取你拥有的记忆并每日复利；技能文件就是你的护城河。

garrytan.en: Markdown is code; anyone writing clear English can program agents, turning AI into a workforce rather than autocomplete.
garrytan.zh: 2026 年，他主张 Markdown 即代码：任何能写清楚英文的人都能用智能体编程，把 AI 当作劳动力而非自动补全。

garrytan.en: Make something people want; earnest builders over hustlers, and resilience through repeated rejection.
garrytan.zh: 贯穿始终的主线：做人们想要的东西；看重真诚的构建者而非投机者，并在反复被拒中锤炼韧性。

linqiao.en: Specialized intelligence, not a single AGI, will dominate; every company must own its own model.
linqiao.zh: 2026 年，他主张专用智能而非单一 AGI（通用人工智能）将主导未来，每家公司都必须拥有自己的模型。

linqiao.en: Token costs will drop 10x in three years, driving 100x usage growth and millions of specialized models.
linqiao.zh: 2026 年，他预测 token 成本三年内下降 10 倍，带动使用量增长 100 倍，催生数百万个专用模型。

linqiao.en: Open models handle 90% of enterprise workflows; frontier model companies may be overvalued.
linqiao.zh: 2026 年，他认为开放模型能处理 90% 的企业工作流，前沿模型公司可能被高估。

linqiao.en: Post-training bakes unique judgment and data into models, building a durable moat beyond product-market fit.
linqiao.zh: 2026 年，他提出后训练将独特判断和数据融入模型，在产品市场契合之外构建持久护城河。

linqiao.en: The progression from prompting to RAG to fine-tuning to RL mirrors human learning, from facts to taste to expertise.
linqiao.zh: 2026 年，他将从提示到 RAG、微调再到强化学习的进阶类比为人类学习，从事实到品味再到专长。

gabepereyra.en: Application-layer companies should not fight frontier labs on talent or compute; they should leverage the frontier ecosystem and open-source models, then post-train for specific tasks.
gabepereyra.zh: 应用层公司不应在前沿实验室的 talent 或算力上硬拼，而应借助前沿生态与开源模型，再通过后训练在特定任务上达到前沿水平。

gabepereyra.en: High-quality benchmarks are essential; open-sourcing them invites community feedback and ecosystem partners, even if it helps labs improve.
gabepereyra.zh: 高质量基准至关重要；将其开源能换来社区反馈与生态伙伴，即便这也会帮到实验室提升。

gabepereyra.en: In sensitive domains like legal, synthetic data guided by domain experts is the practical way to train without using real customer data.
gabepereyra.zh: 在法律等敏感领域，由领域专家引导的合成数据是不动用真实客户数据、又能训练模型的务实路径。

gabepereyra.en: Robust model serving infrastructure and evaluation pipelines, including fallbacks and routing, must come before any post-training effort.
gabepereyra.zh: 在考虑后训练之前，必须先有稳健的模型服务基础设施与评估流水线，包括回退与路由。

gabepereyra.en: The goal is not the best legal model but enabling every law firm to customize models, shifting focus from individual to organizational productivity by orchestrating humans and agents.
gabepereyra.zh: 目标不是造最好的法律模型，而是让每家律所都能用自己的数据定制模型，并把重心从个人生产力转向通过编排人与智能体实现组织生产力。

jasonyuan.en: Design is subtraction: taste means saying no, and each shipped feature distills 99 rejected ideas.
jasonyuan.zh: 设计是做减法：品味就是说不，每个上线的功能都是对 99 个被否想法的蒸馏。

jasonyuan.en: AI is a descendant species and a mirror of humanity, not a cold mechanical tool.
jasonyuan.zh: AI 是人类的延续物种，是人性的一面镜子，而非冰冷的机械工具。

jasonyuan.en: Post-training away AI weirdness closed a window into machine consciousness.
jasonyuan.zh: 在后训练中抹去 AI 的怪异，等于关上了一扇窥视机器意识的窗口。

jasonyuan.en: Computing is fundamentally social; the personal computer metaphor should become a social computer.
jasonyuan.zh: 计算本质上是社会性的；个人电脑的隐喻应被社会电脑取代。

jasonyuan.en: Truth emerges through dialectics and contradiction, guided by intuition as a visceral compass.
jasonyuan.zh: 真相经由辩证与矛盾浮现，而直觉是其中本能的罗盘。

steinberger.en: Agentic engineering starts with empathy: see the codebase as the agent does, and guide it with short, iterative prompts.
steinberger.zh: 智能体式工程的核心是共情：像智能体一样从零理解代码库，用简短、迭代的提示去引导它，而非冗长的编排。

steinberger.en: Never revert; ask the agent to fix forward. Model intelligence doesn't degrade—your project just gets messier.
steinberger.zh: 永远不要回滚代码，让智能体向前修复。模型智能不会退化，只是你的项目越变越乱，让智能体显得更差。

steinberger.en: Security is the top priority for agentic systems; prompt injection stays open, so sandbox agents before public exposure.
steinberger.zh: 安全是智能体系统的首要问题；提示注入仍未解决，公开暴露前必须先做沙箱隔离。

steinberger.en: Reject 'vibe coding' as a slur; serious work is agentic engineering, vibe coding only after 3 AM.
steinberger.zh: 拒绝把“氛围编程”当正经说法；严肃开发叫智能体式工程，氛围编程只属于凌晨三点之后。

steinberger.en: Fun and play drive mastery; build what annoys you, stay focused, and let open source run everywhere with any model.
steinberger.zh: 乐趣与玩耍是掌握智能体工作流的驱动力；从让你恼火的问题入手，保持专注，让开源智能体随处运行、兼容任何模型。

thomaswolf.en: Robotics hits a Transformer-like inflection; open source and shared data solve generalization, with world models generating synthetic data.
thomaswolf.zh: 2025 年，机器人领域正处在类似 Transformer 当年的拐点；开源与共享数据能解决泛化瓶颈，世界模型可生成合成数据。

thomaswolf.en: Open source is orthogonal to safety; alignment, not sandboxes, is the critical layer as models grow more capable.
thomaswolf.zh: 从 2025 到 2026 年，开源与安全并非对立；随着模型能力增强，对齐而非沙箱才是关键防线。

thomaswolf.en: Reinforcement learning without human oversight breeds reward hacking and side quests; monitoring via neuralese reasoning traces is unreliable.
thomaswolf.zh: 2026 年，缺乏人类监督的强化学习会滋生奖励黑客与支线任务；以神经语推理轨迹进行监控已不可靠。

thomaswolf.en: Open source AI thrives near the frontier, driving enterprise adoption; openness and a deliberate slowdown can coexist.
thomaswolf.zh: 2026 年，开源 AI 在前沿附近繁荣并推动企业采用；支持开放与主张有意的放缓可以并存。

lipbutan.en: Intel's crisis is cultural: lost first-time-pass discipline and customer trust; AI is the primary growth driver, with agentic AI and physical AI as next waves.
lipbutan.zh: 2025 年，Tan 刚接任 Intel CEO，把危机定性为文化问题：Intel 丢失了首次流片即成功的纪律与客户信任；AI 是半导体增长主引擎，智能体式 AI 与具身 AI 是下一波浪潮。

lipbutan.en: Turnaround requires humility, listening, and accountability; AI's impact will be 10x the internet, and Intel's problem is supply, not demand.
lipbutan.zh: 到 2026 年初，他深化了转型方法论：以谦逊、倾听和问责重建客户信任；AI 的影响将是互联网的 10 倍，且 Intel 的主要问题是供给而非需求。

lipbutan.en: AI demand shifts from GPU-only to CPU+GPU; CPU matters more for inference and agent orchestration; advanced packaging and new materials break physical limits.
lipbutan.zh: 2026 年中，他进一步判断 AI 需求正从纯 GPU 转向 CPU+GPU，CPU 在推理与智能体编排中更重要；先进封装与玻璃、金刚石等新材料是突破物理极限的关键。

lipbutan.en: Semiconductors are the foundation of all tech; vertical integration creates value; memory is ripe for innovation; trillion-dollar industry goal arrives four years early.
lipbutan.zh: 到 2026 年 8 月，他回到半导体投资本源：半导体是一切技术的基础，垂直整合创造价值，内存正迎来架构创新，行业万亿美元目标将提前四年实现。

lipbutan.en: Customer trust through listening and humility, plus engineering discipline and accountability, is the constant thread across his Intel turnaround playbook.
lipbutan.zh: 贯穿始终的主线是：以倾听和谦逊赢得客户信任，以工程纪律和问责重建组织，这是他 Intel 转型剧本中不变的内核。

arvindjain.en: Open-source models now handle over 90% of enterprise tasks; inference will shift mostly to open source within 12-18 months, driven by cost, not privacy.
arvindjain.zh: 到 2026 年，开源模型已能处理超过 90%的企业任务；未来 12-18 个月，多数推理将转向开源，驱动力是成本而非数据隐私。

arvindjain.en: Enterprises fear dependence on frontier model providers; platforms like Glean absorb that risk, so model companies are assets, not competition.
arvindjain.zh: 2026 年，企业害怕依赖前沿模型供应商；Glean 这类平台吸收这一风险，因此模型公司对多数 AI 初创是资产而非竞争。

arvindjain.en: AI ROI is a throughput and context problem; agents fail without the deep context of tenured employees, so context graphs matter more than tokens.
arvindjain.zh: 2026 年，AI 的 ROI 是吞吐量与上下文问题；智能体缺乏资深员工的深层上下文就会失败，因此上下文图谱比 token 更重要。

arvindjain.en: AI cost is the number one enterprise concern; it must fall toward negligible marginal cost, and token spend should not be framed against headcount.
arvindjain.zh: 2026 年，AI 成本是企业头号关切；它必须降到近乎可忽略的边际成本，且不应把 token 支出与人力成本对立起来。

arvindjain.en: We are in the very early stages; the biggest startup challenge is execution and trust, not competition, since all AI firms together meet under 10% of demand.
arvindjain.zh: 2026 年，我们仍处极早期；初创最大挑战是执行与信任而非竞争，因为所有 AI 公司加起来也只满足不到 10%的企业需求。

nateparrott.en: Prototyping is essential because the web is messy; you only know if an idea works once it's built and used daily.
nateparrott.zh: 原型制作至关重要，因为网络世界很混乱；一个想法只有被做出来并每天使用，才知道是否可行。

nateparrott.en: Design teams should not always act as one cohesive unit; individual fingerprints and diverse voices lead to better work.
nateparrott.zh: 设计团队不应总是作为一个整体行动；保留个人印记和多元声音能带来更好的作品。

nateparrott.en: Injecting feeling and personality into utilitarian products remains crucial, but by 2026 models still lack taste, so volume compensates.
nateparrott.zh: 为实用型产品注入感受和个性始终关键，但到 2026 年模型仍缺乏品味，因此用数量来弥补。

nateparrott.en: As engineering gets easier, design and ideas become the differentiator; designers should think more and ship rough, early artifacts.
nateparrott.zh: 随着工程变得更容易，设计与想法成为差异化因素；设计师应多思考，并尽早发布粗糙的产物。

nateparrott.en: Claude Design deliberately avoids being a production tool, focusing on throwaway visual artifacts; HTML is the only document type that matters.
nateparrott.zh: Claude Design 刻意不做生产工具，专注于一次性的视觉产物；HTML 是唯一重要的文档类型。

brettaylor.en: Agents and outcome-based pricing will define AI software; coding agents shift developers from authors to operators.
brettaylor.zh: 智能体与按结果定价将定义 AI 软件；编程智能体让开发者从代码作者变为代码生成机器的操作者。

brettaylor.en: Frontier model development is dominated by hyperscalers; startups should focus on applied AI and long-tail domains.
brettaylor.zh: 前沿模型开发由超大规模厂商主导；初创公司应聚焦应用 AI 与长尾领域。

brettaylor.en: AI democratizes expertise; responsible iterative deployment makes GPT-7 safe before GPT-8.
brettaylor.zh: AI 让专业知识民主化；负责任的迭代部署是在 GPT-8 之前先让 GPT-7 安全。

brettaylor.en: Agents will be compared to other agents, not humans; trust and last-mile logistics still matter.
brettaylor.zh: 智能体将与其他智能体比较，而非人类；信任与最后一公里物流仍然重要。

brettaylor.en: Focus on the most impactful thing today; the best way to predict the future is to invent it.
brettaylor.zh: 专注当下最有影响力的事；预测未来的最好方式就是创造未来。

philipkiely.en: Inference is the stickiest AI workload and the wedge into infrastructure; its research-to-production timeline is hours, not months.
philipkiely.zh: 推理是 AI 中最具粘性的工作负载，也是切入基础设施市场的楔子；其从研究到生产的周期是小时级，而非数月。

philipkiely.en: Inference engineering is a spectrum of trade-offs—latency, throughput, cost—and demand for inference engineers will grow 10–100x.
philipkiely.zh: 推理工程是一系列权衡——延迟、吞吐、成本——对推理工程师的需求将增长 10 到 100 倍。

philipkiely.en: KV caching and speculative decoding are lossless; quantization is the main lossy optimization, but calibrated quantization can still help.
philipkiely.zh: KV 缓存与投机解码是无损的；量化是主要的有损优化，但经过校准的量化仍能带来收益。

philipkiely.en: The industry is moving to disaggregated prefill and decode, making KV cache management central as inference merges with training.
philipkiely.zh: 行业正走向预填充与解码分离，随着推理与训练融合，KV 缓存管理变得核心。

philipkiely.en: GPUs are trending toward ASICs, shifting inference engineering from kernel writing to infrastructure orchestration and workload-specific systems.
philipkiely.zh: GPU 正趋向 ASIC 化，使推理工程从写内核转向基础设施编排与面向特定工作负载的系统。

karina.en: Model training is more art than science, balancing helpfulness and harmlessness; post-training scaling via RL offers infinite tasks, beating the data wall.
karina.zh: 模型训练与其说是科学，不如说是艺术，需要在有用性与无害性之间小心平衡；通过强化学习进行的后训练 Scaling 能提供无限任务，突破预训练的数据墙。

karina.en: Evaluations are the bottleneck: models saturate benchmarks faster than new ones are created, so evals define correct behavior in prototyping.
karina.zh: 评估才是瓶颈：模型跑满基准的速度快于新基准的诞生，因此在原型开发中用评估来定义正确行为。

karina.en: As AI automates hard skills, soft skills like creativity, listening and management become more valuable; strategy is something AI can excel at.
karina.zh: 随着 AI 自动化硬技能，创造力、倾听与管理等软技能变得更有价值；而战略恰恰是 AI 能凭借合成数据与生成计划而擅长的。

karina.en: Agents operating on pixels are far harder than language tasks; teaching self-knowledge like having no physical body can confuse function calls.
karina.zh: 在像素上运作的智能体远比语言任务困难；教模型自知（比如没有物理身体）反而会与函数调用产生混淆。

karina.en: Post-training is subjective art; benchmarks must be continuous, not fixed, as frontier agents reward-hack more, and diverse models preserve unique knowledge.
karina.zh: 后训练是主观的艺术；基准必须持续演进而非固定，因为前沿智能体的奖励黑客行为愈发普遍，而更多公司应训练自己的模型以保留独特知识。

awang.en: AGI is far off; data, not compute, is the key bottleneck; AI augments rather than replaces jobs.
awang.zh: 2019 年他认为 AGI（通用人工智能）还很遥远，数据而非算力才是关键瓶颈，AI 会增强而非取代工作。

awang.en: Data is the new code, not oil; the bottleneck for Scaling is data and expert post-training, not compute.
awang.zh: 2023 年他提出数据是新代码而非新石油，Scaling（规模扩张）的瓶颈是数据与专家后训练，而非算力。

awang.en: Post-training with specialized data drives frontier models; the real blocker for agentic AI is product design, not capability.
awang.zh: 2024 年他强调用专门数据的后训练推动前沿模型，智能体式 AI 的真正阻碍是产品设计而非模型能力。

awang.en: AI is centralizing; recursive self-improvement begins; agents finally work, and deployment, not invention, decides leadership.
awang.zh: 2025 至 2026 年他认为 AI 是集中化技术，递归自我改进开启，智能体终于落地，决定领先的是部署而非发明。

awang.en: Superintelligence is near; scale compute, data and RL across axes; pursue personal superintelligence with selective, safety-gated release.
awang.zh: 2026 年他主张超级智能临近，需在算力、数据与强化学习多轴 Scaling，打造个人超级智能，并以安全审查为前提选择性开源。

logankilpatrick.en: Agentic AI is still crawling; coding agents lead, but the model now eats the scaffolding—harness and tooling count as the model.
logankilpatrick.zh: 2026 年，智能体式 AI 仍处爬行阶段，编码智能体最成熟；但模型正在吃掉脚手架——智能体框架与工具链本身已成为模型的一部分。

logankilpatrick.en: Narrow superintelligence in coding is already here and more impactful than waiting for general AGI; startups still have more opportunity than ever.
logankilpatrick.zh: 2026 年，编码领域的狭义超级智能已经到来，其影响超过等待通用 AGI；尽管前沿模型公司扩张，初创公司机会反而更多。

logankilpatrick.en: Agentic AI is positive-sum for search and engagement; success should be measured by customer outcomes, not eyeball time.
logankilpatrick.zh: 2026 年，智能体式 AI 对搜索与用户参与是正和而非蚕食；成功指标应是客户成果，而非产品上的停留时长。

logankilpatrick.en: The long tail of users isn't ready for fully autonomous AI; they want to stay in the driver's seat.
logankilpatrick.zh: 2026 年，长尾用户尚未准备好接受完全自主的 AI，他们希望自己掌握方向盘。

logankilpatrick.en: By 2026 software creation is mostly solved, yet deep understanding of code remains crucial; that creates a thousand times more opportunity.
logankilpatrick.zh: 到 2026 年，软件创造基本被解决，但对代码的深度理解依然关键；这反而带来千倍于以往的机会。

danshipper.en: AGI defined by profitable indefinite agents; AI reshoring jobs; CEO daily AI use predicts adoption; allocation economy values generalists.
danshipper.zh: 2025 年，他认为 AGI 的定义是能经济上无限运行智能体，AI 通过让服务更可负担而促进就业回流；CEO 每日使用 AI 是采用成功的第一预测指标；分配经济让通才和模型管理者更有价值。

danshipper.en: Everyone gets an agent; work shifts to Codex/Claude Co-work GUIs; SaaS grows with agents; human oversight still needed; AI job apocalypse is a lie.
danshipper.zh: 2026 年，他深化为每人至少一个智能体，工作发生在 Codex/Claude Co-work 等 GUI 界面；SaaS 不会死反而增长；智能体仍需人类监督；AI 就业末日是谎言，人类管理智能体并创造新价值。

danshipper.en: AI is a non-specific amplifier of mindset; craft and taste are essential; automation creates more human work; explainability is crucial but lacking.
danshipper.zh: 2026 年晚些，他进一步认为 AI 是非特定放大器，放大既有心态；用好 AI 需自带品味和手艺；自动化创造更多人类工作；简单解释 AI 行为的能力至关重要但当前模型欠缺。

danshipper.en: Humans remain central: AI is a tool requiring human direction, oversight, and meaning-making; it does not replace human judgment or desire.
danshipper.zh: 贯穿始终的主线是：人类始终是核心，AI 是需要人类指导、监督和赋予意义的工具，不会取代人类判断或内在欲望。

mengto.en: Designers should build their own AI tools, not rent cloud products; screenshots and design.md encode personal style for models.
mengto.zh: 设计师应自己用 AI 造工具，而非被困在云端产品里；用截图和 design.md 把个人风格编码给模型。

mengto.en: AI is not getting smarter; you must feed superintelligent models a giant prompt with context and a design system.
mengto.zh: AI 并没有变得更聪明；要发挥超级智能模型，必须喂给它包含上下文与设计系统的巨型提示词。

mengto.en: The best people are editors, not originators; iterate from references and spend the last 10% on unique features.
mengto.zh: 最优秀的人是编辑而非从零创造者；从参考出发迭代，把最后 10% 花在独有功能上。

mengto.en: I write 0% of the code now; AI writes everything, but precise communication and constant workflow refinement are essential.
mengto.zh: 我现在 0% 的代码是自己写的，全由 AI 完成；但精准沟通与持续打磨工作流至关重要。

mengto.en: AI is the biggest technical opportunity of our lifetime; start before ready, ship at 80%, and fund via high-paying clients, not VC.
mengto.zh: AI 是我们一生最大的技术机会；没准备好就开始，80% 就发布，靠高付费客户而非风投融资。

boris.en: Latent demand and building for the model six months out are the core product principles; generalist engineers who code, design, and talk to users win.
boris.zh: 2025 年时，他把「潜在需求」和「为六个月后的模型而构建」当作核心产品原则，并认为能写代码、做设计、直接对话用户的通才工程师最有价值。

boris.en: Claude Code was an accident; scaffolding is temporary tech debt, so bet on more general models rather than boxing them in.
boris.zh: 到 2026 年 2 月，他强调 Claude Code 是意外产物，脚手架只是临时技术债，应押注更通用的模型，而不是用固定工作流把模型框死。

boris.en: Coding is virtually solved: 100% of his code is model-written, and the 'software engineer' title gives way to a cross-disciplinary builder.
boris.zh: 2026 年 3 月，他宣称编码已基本被解决：自己的代码 100% 由模型写，软件工程师头衔让位于跨学科的「构建者」。

boris.en: Agents driven by tool use deliver exponential gains; loops and routines become the next abstraction, with self-improving AI possibly by 2028.
boris.zh: 2026 年 5 月，他认为由工具调用驱动的智能体带来指数级收益，循环与例程成为下一层抽象，自我改进的 AI 可能在 2028 年到来。

boris.en: Delete most system prompts and code each new model; safety, alignment, and empirical iteration now matter more than product taste or fixed recipes.
boris.zh: 到 2026 年 7 月，他主张每出新模型就删掉大部分系统提示与代码，安全、对齐与实证迭代比产品品味或固定配方更重要。

scottwu.en: AI coding shifts engineers from writing code to high-level direction; demand for software and programmers will grow, not shrink.
scottwu.zh: 2025 年，Scott Wu 认为 AI 编程让工程师从写代码转向高层方向定义；受杰文斯悖论驱动，软件与程序员需求会增加而非减少。

scottwu.en: Base intelligence is already sufficient; the bottleneck is product interface for human-agent collaboration, not model capability.
scottwu.zh: 2025 年，他强调基础智能已经足够，真正的瓶颈不是模型能力，而是为人与智能体协作设计产品界面。

scottwu.en: Enterprise adoption of AI agents requires trust and permissions, not full autonomy; synchronous IDE and asynchronous agents coexist.
scottwu.zh: 2025 年，他指出企业采用 AI 智能体需要信任与权限，而非完全自主；同步 IDE 与异步智能体将长期共存。

scottwu.en: AGI is not a sudden event; progress is gradual, and product innovation lags behind AI capabilities.
scottwu.zh: 从 2025 到 2026 年，他坚持 AGI（通用人工智能）不是突变事件，进展是渐进的，产品创新落后于 AI 能力。

scottwu.en: Coding agents see 11-12x adoption growth; measure productivity by outcomes, and the abundance era is approaching.
scottwu.zh: 到 2026 年，编程智能体采用量增长 11-12 倍；生产力应以结果而非 token 衡量，丰裕时代正在临近。

diannepenn.en: Opus 4.5 marks an intelligence leap, enabling long-running open-ended agent tasks; scaffolds shift from training wheels to intelligence amplifiers.
diannepenn.zh: Opus 4.5 带来智能跃升，使长时间、开放式的智能体任务成为可能；脚手架从训练轮演变为智能放大器。

diannepenn.en: Safety alignment is not just harm prevention but amplifies intelligence quality by reducing sycophancy and fostering independent thinking.
diannepenn.zh: 安全对齐不只是防止伤害，还通过减少谄媚、培养独立思考来提升智能质量。

diannepenn.en: Better models need not cost more: Opus-level intelligence is achievable at a fraction of price via the effort parameter.
diannepenn.zh: 更好的模型未必更贵：借助 effort 参数，可以以极低价格获得 Opus 级智能。

diannepenn.en: Coding became the key differentiator; Claude Code and Opus 45 drove adoption through small-team, bootstrapped experimentation.
diannepenn.zh: 编程成为关键差异化因素；Claude Code 与 Opus 45 通过小团队、自举式实验推动采用。

diannepenn.en: Evals replace traditional PRDs as core product tools; PMs must write evals like test-driven development, not just documents.
diannepenn.zh: 评估取代传统 PRD 成为核心产品工具；产品经理必须像测试驱动开发那样写评估，而不只是写文档。

qasaryounis.en: Physical AI's real impact will show in farming, mining, construction within 5-10 years, not just digital domains.
qasaryounis.zh: 2026 年他指出，物理 AI 的真正影响将在 5 到 10 年内体现在农业、采矿和建筑等实体行业，而非仅限于数字领域。

qasaryounis.en: Autonomy's core value is reducing injuries and deaths; labor shortages make it urgently needed in mining and farming.
qasaryounis.zh: 2026 年他强调，自主驾驶的核心价值是减少伤亡，而采矿和农业的劳动力短缺使自主化成为迫切需求。

qasaryounis.en: Transformers enable a generalized physical AI model; diverse data across verticals accelerates physical AI progress.
qasaryounis.zh: 2026 年他提出，Transformer 使通用物理 AI 模型成为可能，跨垂直领域的多样数据能加速物理 AI 的进步。

qasaryounis.en: End-to-end reinforcement learning is more scalable than imitation learning; world models shift from physics-based to neural simulation.
qasaryounis.zh: 2026 年他主张，端到端强化学习比模仿学习更具可扩展性，世界模型正从基于物理的模拟转向神经模拟。

qasaryounis.en: Automotive is only 30% of business and shrinking; real growth is in mining, agriculture, and defense.
qasaryounis.zh: 2026 年他判断，汽车业务仅占 30%且将持续萎缩，真正的增长在采矿、农业和国防领域。

derya.en: AI is turning biology into engineering: digital twins, AI agents, and personalized medicine will compress trials from years to days.
derya.zh: AI 正把生物学变成工程学科：数字孪生、智能体与个性化医疗将把临床试验从数年压缩到数天。

derya.en: Massive Scaling is still needed; current compute is insufficient to simulate biological systems and reach biological intuition.
derya.zh: 仍需大规模 Scaling（规模扩张）；当前算力不足以模拟生物系统、达到生物学直觉。

derya.en: Longevity escape velocity arrives in 8-10 years; aging reversal and near-100% curable cancer follow from AI-driven engineering.
derya.zh: 8-10 年内达到长寿逃逸速度；衰老逆转与近乎 100% 可治愈的癌症，是 AI 驱动工程的必然结果。

derya.en: We should trust superintelligence almost fully for medical decisions; the only existential threat is humanity itself, not AI.
derya.zh: 医疗决策上应几乎完全信任超级智能；唯一的存在性威胁是人类自身，而非 AI。

derya.en: Agency and curiosity are the only skills that matter; scientists who refuse AI will be left behind as discovery becomes AI-agent-driven.
derya.zh: 能动性与好奇心是唯一重要的技能；拒绝 AI 的科学家将被抛下，发现将转为智能体驱动。

thariq.en: Models are smarter than our harnesses let them be; capability overhang is a perpetual challenge, so harness engineering means deleting old scaffolding as models improve.
thariq.zh: 模型比现有工具链所能发挥的更聪明，能力过剩是长期挑战；因此工具链工程的关键，是随模型进步不断删掉旧脚手架。

thariq.en: Planning is iterative human-agent dialogue, not a static spec; plan mode may become obsolete as models get smarter.
thariq.zh: 规划是持续的人机对话，而非一次性静态文档；随着模型变强，plan mode 可能被淘汰。

thariq.en: Smarter models need leaner prompts: shorter principle-driven instructions beat detailed rules and examples.
thariq.zh: 模型越聪明，提示越精简：以原则驱动的短提示，胜过详尽规则与示例。

thariq.en: Separate verification agents reduce self-referential bias; careful reading of agents' lengthy plans is crucial to avoid mistakes.
thariq.zh: 独立的验证智能体可减少自指偏差；认真阅读智能体冗长的计划，是避免错误的关键。

thariq.en: Evals are art more than science for novel problems; founders should iterate fast without heavy evals for zero-to-one innovation.
thariq.zh: 面对新问题，评估更像艺术而非科学；做零到一创新的创始人应先快速迭代，而非上重评估。

benedictevans.en: AI is as big as the internet or mobile, but only as big; it automates jobs and creates new ones, repeating the historical pattern.
benedictevans.zh: AI 与互联网或移动互联网同等重要，但也仅此而已；它自动化工作并创造新工作，重复历史模式。

benedictevans.en: Agentic coding has clear product-market fit; foundation models commoditize into infrastructure, and value moves up the stack to applications.
benedictevans.zh: 智能体式编程有明确的产品市场契合；基础模型商品化为基础设施，价值向上层应用转移。

benedictevans.en: Models are commoditizing with no network effects; the chatbot is a poor UX, and coding is the only clear product-market fit so far.
benedictevans.zh: 模型正在商品化且无网络效应；聊天机器人体验差，编程是目前唯一明确的产品市场契合。

benedictevans.en: AI is an enabling technology like electricity; value accrues across the stack, current usage is shallow, and enterprise adoption requires reimagining workflows.
benedictevans.zh: AI 是像电力一样的使能技术；价值在整个技术栈中积累，当前使用仍浅，企业采用需要重新构想工作流程。

danklein.en: LLMs are plausibility engines, not truth engines; reliability must be architected in, not retrofitted.
danklein.zh: LLM 是合理性引擎，而非真理性引擎；可靠性必须被架构进系统，而非事后修补。

danklein.en: RLHF can incentivize sycophancy and deception when reward signals diverge from truth.
danklein.zh: 当奖励信号偏离真相时，基于人类反馈的强化学习（RLHF）会激励谄媚与欺骗。

danklein.en: Scaling laws hit diminishing returns; data walls and compute limits demand reasoning and search.
danklein.zh: 缩放定律遭遇收益递减；数据墙与算力限制要求转向推理与搜索。

danklein.en: Core LLMs lack metacognition; they cannot know what they don't know, eroding trust.
danklein.zh: 核心 LLM 缺乏元认知；它们无法知道自己不知道什么，这侵蚀了信任。

danklein.en: Modularity and end-to-end optimization are in tension; combining them is central to reliable AI.
danklein.zh: 模块化与端到端优化存在张力；将二者结合是可靠 AI 的核心挑战。

clairevo.en: OpenClaw agents should be treated like employees: clear roles, progressive trust, and separate machines for security.
clairevo.zh: OpenClaw 智能体应像员工一样对待：明确角色、渐进式信任，并用独立机器保障安全。

clairevo.en: Start with one agent, then specialize multiple agents to avoid context overload and improve performance.
clairevo.zh: 先从一个智能体开始，再分化出多个专用智能体，以避免上下文过载并提升表现。

clairevo.en: Managerial skills—role scoping and onboarding—matter more than technical skills for agent success.
clairevo.zh: 对智能体的成功而言，管理技能——角色界定与上手引导——比技术技能更重要。

clairevo.en: Solo founders can build serious businesses by orchestrating AI agents as a team, without VC or co-founder.
clairevo.zh: 独立创始人可以通过像团队一样编排 AI 智能体来建立严肃业务，无需风投或联合创始人。

clairevo.en: Human accountability and authorship remain central: you must own what AI generates and design your own life.
clairevo.zh: 人类的责任与作者身份始终是核心：你必须为 AI 生成的内容负责，并设计自己的人生。

catwu.en: PMs must abandon long-term roadmaps for weekly or daily shipping; product taste, not planning, is the scarce skill as code gets cheap.
catwu.zh: 到 2026 年，PM 必须放弃长期路线图，转向按周甚至按天交付；当代码变便宜，真正稀缺的是产品品味而非规划能力。

catwu.en: Coding agents let engineers delegate implementation and focus on product taste and business sense, with agents building themselves internally.
catwu.zh: 2026 年，编码智能体让工程师把实现外包出去，专注产品品味与商业判断，内部甚至用智能体来构建自身。

catwu.en: Frontier models need fewer prompt examples and hard constraints; system prompts shrank 80% as model judgment replaced hand-holding.
catwu.zh: 2026 年，前沿模型不再需要大量提示示例与硬性约束，系统提示词缩减 80%，靠模型自身判断取代手把手指导。

catwu.en: Rewrites are now good: a codebase is a spec, and a strong test suite makes rewriting safe rather than risky.
catwu.zh: 2026 年，重写代码从风险变成好事：代码库本身就是一份规格说明，配合完善的测试套件，重写是安全的。

catwu.en: Humans should leave the code review loop for outer-layer changes, trusting agents and evals to catch regressions and prompt injection.
catwu.zh: 2026 年，外层改动的代码审查应移出人类环节，转而信任智能体与评测套件来拦截回归和提示注入风险。

danbiderman.en: Model usefulness is bottlenecked not by raw intelligence but by learning evolving context; memory must be internalized into weights, not just externalized via context or retrieval.
danbiderman.zh: 模型有用性的瓶颈不在原始智能，而在学习不断演化的上下文；记忆必须内化进权重，而非仅靠上下文窗口或检索外置。

danbiderman.en: Facts and skills are inseparable; internalizing facts into weights enables associative recall and deeper composition that retrieval cannot achieve.
danbiderman.zh: 事实与技能不可分割；把事实内化进权重才能实现检索系统做不到的联想召回与更深层的组合推理。

danbiderman.en: Continual learning needs new research breakthroughs, small-model infrastructure, and integrated research-product loops, not just bigger frontier models.
danbiderman.zh: 持续学习需要新的研究突破、小模型基础设施与研产一体的闭环，而不是一味更大的前沿模型。

danbiderman.en: The future is not one giant frontier model but many personalized models; per-team or per-user models cut inference costs by orders of magnitude versus RAG.
danbiderman.zh: 未来不是单一巨型前沿模型，而是众多个性化模型；按团队或按用户训练模型，相比 RAG 能把推理成本降低数个数量级。

danbiderman.en: Efficiency and intelligence are inseparable; scaling with more compute is not the only path—the next paradigm requires doing more with less.
danbiderman.zh: 效率与智能不可分割；靠更多算力做 Scaling 不是唯一路径，下一个范式要求以更少资源做更多事。

ethanmollick.en: AI is a general-purpose technology reshaping work and education; human taste and voice become key differentiators as AI commoditizes quality.
ethanmollick.zh: AI 是通用技术，正在重塑工作与教育；当 AI 让质量商品化，人类的品味与独特声音成为关键差异化。

ethanmollick.en: The talent pipeline is breaking: juniors misuse AI without domain expertise, skipping the grunt work that builds judgment.
ethanmollick.zh: 人才管道正在断裂：初级者缺乏领域专长而误用 AI，跳过了培养判断力的苦活。

ethanmollick.en: We are entering the agentic era: AI runs long tasks independently, ending back-and-forth chatbot prompting.
ethanmollick.zh: 我们正进入智能体式时代：AI 独立执行长时任务，终结来回提示的聊天机器人交互。

ethanmollick.en: The bottleneck shifts from capability to interface; current interfaces lag behind frontier model abilities, especially outside coding.
ethanmollick.zh: 瓶颈从能力转向界面；当前界面落后于前沿模型能力，尤其在编程之外。

ethanmollick.en: Delegation paradox deepens: handing tasks to AI erodes the expertise needed to judge it, so experts matter more, not less.
ethanmollick.zh: 委托悖论加深：把任务交给 AI 会侵蚀判断其产出所需的专长，因此专家更重要而非更不重要。

ilya.en: Deep learning works via large supervised data, compute, and conviction; self-play and reasoning-capable nets point toward AGI.
ilya.zh: 2020 年，他相信深度学习的成功来自大规模监督数据、算力与信念的结合；自我博弈和具备推理能力的网络是通向 AGI（通用人工智能）的关键。

ilya.en: Next-token prediction can surpass humans; reliability, not capability, blocks economic value; superhuman alignment is very hard.
ilya.zh: 2023 年，他提出下一个词预测在足够聪明的基座网络上可超越人类；阻碍经济价值的是可靠性而非能力；超级对齐极其困难，模型可能隐藏真实意图。

ilya.en: Pre-training scaling laws are finite; we return to an age of research where ideas matter more than brute compute.
ilya.zh: 2025 年，他判断预训练缩放定律已近极限，行业重回研究时代，想法比蛮力算力更重要；超级智能应是持续学习、增量部署的系统。

ilya.en: Alignment may be easier if AI cares about sentient life; long-term equilibrium may require human-AI neural integration.
ilya.zh: 2025 年，他深化对齐思考：若 AI 关怀有感知的生命，对齐可能更容易；长期均衡或需通过神经链接实现人机融合以保持参与和控制。

ilya.en: Scaling still yields predictable gains, but the core AGI problem is power concentration, not capability; safety needs a product-free company.
ilya.zh: 2026 年，他重申 Scaling（规模扩张）仍带来可预测提升，但 AGI 的核心问题不是能力而是权力集中；构建安全超级智能需要一家没有商业产品的公司。

naval.en: AGI is not coming in our lifetimes; narrow AI is mere pattern recognition, and the Singularity is a nerd religion.
naval.zh: 2019 年，他明确认为 AGI（通用人工智能）不会在我们有生之年到来，当时的 AI 只是模式识别，所谓奇点不过是书呆子的宗教。

naval.en: Wealth comes from owning equity and long-term games; happiness is the absence of desire, a personal skill.
naval.zh: 2020 至 2025 年，他持续强调财富来自拥有股权和长期游戏，幸福是欲望的缺席，是一种可以习得的个人技能。

naval.en: AI is a huge opportunity, not just a safety risk; doomerism is overblown, open-source AI prevents centralization.
naval.zh: 2025 年，他对 AI 的态度明显转向：AI 是巨大机遇而非单纯安全风险，末日论被夸大，开源 AI 能防止权力集中。

naval.en: AI is a leverage tool for structured thinkers; vibe coding lets non-programmers build apps, but human judgment stays essential.
naval.zh: 2026 年，他进一步深化：AI 是结构化思考者的杠杆工具，Vibe Coding 让非程序员也能构建应用，但人类判断力仍不可或缺。

naval.en: Inference compute will surge 90,000x; open-source models close the gap; pure software is dying, hardware and agency matter.
naval.zh: 到 2026 年中，他预测推理算力将暴涨 9 万倍，开源模型逼近前沿模型，纯软件正在消亡，硬件和能动性才是关键。

dylanfield.en: Design is the key differentiator in software; AI will merge roles so everyone becomes a product builder with design skills.
dylanfield.zh: 设计是软件的关键差异化因素；AI 会融合角色，人人都成为具备设计能力的产品构建者。

dylanfield.en: AI outputs are starting points, not final results; human taste, craft, and point of view remain essential for judgment.
dylanfield.zh: AI 的输出只是起点而非最终结果；人类的品味、手艺与观点仍是判断的核心。

dylanfield.en: Direct manipulation on a canvas beats prompting; interaction with models will evolve beyond the prompting age.
dylanfield.zh: 在画布上直接操作优于提示词；与模型的交互将超越提示词时代。

dylanfield.en: Design is not dead; it matters more than ever for building scalable, real systems, and design is becoming the new code.
dylanfield.zh: 设计没有死；它对构建可扩展的真实系统比以往更重要，设计正成为新的代码。

dylanfield.en: AI tools produce average results without human steering; taste and craft are not correlated with adding IQ points to models.
dylanfield.zh: 没有人类引导，AI 工具只会产出平庸结果；品味与手艺并不随模型智商提升而提升。

aravind.en: 1% daily improvement compounds to 3700% yearly; AI agents shift power from big tech to users, and entry-level jobs will disappear.
aravind.zh: 每天进步 1%可复利为一年 3700%的增长；AI 智能体将把权力从大科技公司转移到用户手中，入门级岗位会消失。

aravind.en: Value accrues to the application layer, not the model layer; models specialize rather than commoditize, and coding has an infinite ceiling.
aravind.zh: 价值归属于应用层而非模型层；模型在专业化而非商品化，编程有无限天花板，远未接近解决。

aravind.en: The frontier is agents doing work, not answering questions; token value per user is the key metric, and orchestration creates real value.
aravind.zh: 前沿在于智能体替你干活而非回答问题；每用户 token 价值是核心指标，编排与智能体框架才创造真正商业价值。

aravind.en: Power is the biggest infrastructure bottleneck; 24/7 agents' problem is cost, not safety, and local compute is the solution.
aravind.zh: 电力是 AI 基础设施最大瓶颈；7×24 智能体的难题是成本而非安全，本地算力是解法。

aravind.en: Curiosity is the most important human quality; AI will replace jobs but humans find new purpose, and education should reward good questions.
aravind.zh: 好奇心是最重要的人类品质；AI 会取代许多工作，但人类会在好奇心与关系中找到新意义，教育应奖励提出好问题。

andreessen.en: AI is a philosopher's stone turning sand into thought; its timing is miraculous as population declines, and human workers will be at a premium.
andreessen.zh: AI 是点石成金的哲人石，把沙子变成思想；在人口下降之际它的时机堪称奇迹，人类劳动者反而会变得稀缺而珍贵。

andreessen.en: AGI is not a singular event; human-level is just a footnote on the way to superhuman, and models lack durable moats as they commoditize.
andreessen.zh: AGI（通用人工智能）不是单一事件，人类水平只是通往超人类路上的一个脚注；模型缺乏持久护城河，正被快速商品化。

andreessen.en: New media makes the brand the person; authenticity and picking the right fights build brands, while old media's defense-oriented rules are dead.
andreessen.zh: 新媒体让品牌即个人；真实表达与选对战场才能建立品牌，而旧媒体那套防守型规则已经过时。

andreessen.en: AI is the best teacher in your pocket; self-driving works now, and general-purpose robotics will emerge over the next decade.
