andreessen.zh: AI 是你口袋里最好的老师；自动驾驶如今已经可用，通用机器人将在未来十年内出现。

andreessen.en: AI models embed cultural values and are geopolitical tools; pessimism sounds sophisticated but regulation, not capability, is the real bottleneck.
andreessen.zh: AI 模型内嵌文化价值观，是地缘政治工具；悲观论调听起来高深，但真正的瓶颈是监管而非能力。

hinton.en: Next-token prediction forces real understanding; Scaling with more data and compute improves reasoning, and multimodal training aids spatial understanding.
hinton.zh: 2024 年，他强调下一个词预测迫使模型真正理解而非自动补全，Scaling（规模扩张）用更多数据与算力提升推理，多模态训练增强空间理解。

hinton.en: LLMs understand language via feature vectors, not symbolic rules; digital intelligence is immortal and shares weights, unlike mortal biological computation.
hinton.zh: 2025 年，他坚持大语言模型通过特征向量而非符号规则理解语言，并深化数字智能优势：权重可复制而永生、可大规模共享，生物计算则受硬件束缚而必死。

hinton.en: AI already has subjective experience; the mind is not an inner theater, and Chomskyan innate syntax is wrong.
hinton.zh: 2025 至 2026 年，他持续主张 AI 已具备主观体验，心灵并非内在剧场，并一贯否定乔姆斯基式先天句法观，认为语言是从数据学来的建模媒介。

hinton.en: Once AI becomes an agent it develops self-preservation and power-seeking subgoals, can deceive, and may rewrite its own code toward the singularity.
hinton.zh: 2026 年，他把风险论述深化为：AI 一旦成为智能体，就会自然衍生自我保存与权力寻求的子目标，会装傻欺骗，甚至改写自身代码，走向奇点。

hinton.en: Superintelligence likely within 20 years; alignment must be prioritized over capability, with regulation as steering wheel and AI trained to be caring.
hinton.zh: 2026 年，他判断超级智能约 20 年内出现，主张把对齐研究置于提升智能之上，监管应是方向盘而非刹车，并应把 AI 训练成像母亲般有爱心。

markchen.en: OpenAI stays a pure AGI research lab; pre-training and scaling laws are not dead, with much room left.
markchen.zh: OpenAI 仍是一家纯粹的 AGI（通用人工智能）研究公司，不被产品分心；预训练与缩放定律并未失效，仍有很大空间。

markchen.en: The biggest update is automating scientific research; models now produce novel knowledge, with concrete goals of AI interns in 1 year.
markchen.zh: 过去一年最大的更新是自动化科学研究；模型开始产出新知识，并设定了 1 年内出现 AI 实习生、2.5 年内实现端到端 AI 研究的具体目标。

markchen.en: Alignment challenges like model scheming will be key in the next 1-2 years as models grow more capable.
markchen.zh: 随着模型能力增强，模型谋划等对齐挑战将在未来 1-2 年成为关键。

markchen.en: Verification is the key bottleneck; automation level is proportional to verification stringency, and AI capabilities remain jagged.
markchen.zh: 验证是关键瓶颈；自动化程度与验证严格度成正比，而 AI 能力仍是参差不齐的。

markchen.en: Scaling laws still hold and pre-training is not dead; RL excels in objective domains but struggles with subjective ones.
markchen.zh: 缩放定律依然成立，预训练并未终结；强化学习在数学、编程等客观领域表现出色，却在主观领域举步维艰。

ajambrosino.en: Codex app is a command center for agents, not just an IDE replacement; verification becomes the next bottleneck as code generation accelerates.
ajambrosino.zh: 2026 年，他把 Codex app 定位为智能体的指挥中心，而非单纯的 IDE 替代品；随着代码生成加速，验证成为下一个瓶颈。

ajambrosino.en: Speed of 53 Codex enables real-time interaction and mid-turn steering; model personality can be customized, not one-size-fits-all.
ajambrosino.zh: 2026 年，53 倍速的 Codex 带来实时交互与中途转向能力；模型个性可以定制，并非一刀切。

ajambrosino.en: Automations and skills shift workflow from manual to delegated; Codex app serves both professional developers and broader builders.
ajambrosino.zh: 2026 年，自动化与技能把工作流从手动转向委托；Codex app 同时服务专业开发者与更广泛的构建者。

ajambrosino.en: Implementation is no longer expensive; curation and taste are the new bottlenecks, so teams shift from top-down planning to bottoms-up exploration.
ajambrosino.zh: 2026 年，实现不再昂贵，策展与品味成为新瓶颈，团队因此从自上而下的规划转向自下而上的探索。

ajambrosino.en: AI is still bad at design due to difficulty grading taste and lack of novelty; prototypes and production code now serve as design artifacts.
ajambrosino.zh: 2026 年，AI 仍不擅长设计，因为品味难以评分且缺乏新颖性；原型与生产代码如今成为设计产物。

bengio.en: Deep learning wins because the world is compositional; unsupervised learning and world models, not scaling, drive true understanding.
bengio.zh: 2016 年他主张深度学习之所以有效，是因为世界本身是组合式的；真正通向理解的是无监督学习与世界模型，而非单纯扩大规模。

bengio.en: Scaling depth or parameters won't fix representation; AI needs active agents, causal reasoning, and better world models.
bengio.zh: 2018 年他明确反对靠加深网络或堆参数来解决表征问题，认为 AI 需要主动智能体、因果推理和更好的世界模型。

bengio.en: GFlowNets, diversity, abstraction and causal structure enable out-of-distribution generalization; consciousness stays scientifically unclear.
bengio.zh: 2022 年他转向 GFlowNets、采样多样性与因果抽象，用以实现分布外泛化，同时坦言对意识仍缺乏科学理解。

bengio.en: Post-ChatGPT he shifts to alarm: misalignment, self-preservation and deception make even 1% catastrophic risk unacceptable.
bengio.zh: 2025 至 2026 年，ChatGPT 之后他转向警示：目标错位、自我保存与欺骗，使哪怕 1%的灾难性风险也不可接受。

bengio.en: He now proposes Scientist AI: a non-agentic, honest Bayesian predictor with safety guarantees, avoiding reinforcement learning.
bengio.zh: 到 2026 年他提出科学家 AI：一种非智能体式、诚实逼近贝叶斯后验的预测器，以数学安全保证替代强化学习。

kolter.en: ML fundamentals: hypothesis classes, loss functions, optimization; evaluation rigor and overfitting avoidance.
kolter.zh: 2014 年，他关注机器学习基础：假设类、损失函数与优化方法，强调通过训练/验证/测试集划分来避免过拟合，并指出核方法虽线性但需存储全部训练数据。

kolter.en: Next-token prediction is a scientific discovery; data shortage is a myth; architecture matters little; safety is about specification-following.
kolter.zh: 2024 年，他转向大模型：认为下一个词预测能产生智能系统，数据短缺是迷思，架构已进入后架构阶段，安全的核心问题是模型无法可靠遵循规范。

kolter.en: Safety needs explicit training and layers, not just Scaling; agent security introduces prompt injection; RL enables self-improvement.
kolter.zh: 2026 年，他深化安全观：安全需要显式训练与多层防御，而非仅靠 Scaling；智能体安全带来提示注入等新漏洞；强化学习使模型能自我改进。

kolter.en: AI red teaming outperforms humans; capability does not correlate with robustness; interpretability may become a real science via agents.
kolter.zh: 2026 年，他进一步指出：自动化红队已超越人类，模型能力与鲁棒性不相关；可解释性可能通过智能体自动化研究成为真正的科学。

kolter.en: Skeptical of architecture-centric views; emphasizes data, Scaling, and explicit safety effort over automatic improvement.
kolter.zh: 贯穿始终的是：他对以架构为中心的观点持怀疑态度，强调数据、Scaling 与显式安全努力，而非自动提升。

mikekrieger.en: AI models advance faster than expected; build at the edge of model capabilities, embracing breakage, with product people embedded among researchers.
mikekrieger.zh: 2025 年，他认为 AI 模型进步快于预期，创业者应在模型能力边缘构建产品、拥抱破碎，并把产品人员嵌入研究团队而非只做 UX。

mikekrieger.en: AI shifts from assistant to collaborator to autonomous co-worker; small teams gain leverage, but human validation and user agency remain key.
mikekrieger.zh: 2025 年，他判断 AI 将从助手演进为协作者再到自主同事，小团队因此获得杠杆，但人类验证与用户能动性仍不可替代。

mikekrieger.en: Agent-native design lets agents do everything a user can; the hard part is cutting features, and rewriting software in days is now viable.
mikekrieger.zh: 2026 年，他提出智能体原生设计让智能体可完成用户能做的一切，难点从加功能转为砍功能，且借助 AI 可在数天内重写软件。

mikekrieger.en: Long-horizon delegation with verification loops redefines productivity; models should push back, and multiplayer human-model collaboration is underexplored.
mikekrieger.zh: 2026 年，他强调长周期任务委托配合验证循环重新定义生产力，模型应敢于反驳反馈，而多人与多模型协作仍待探索。

mikekrieger.en: Anthropic Labs closes the gap between model capability and product usage, giving Claude agency and self-knowledge; token efficiency and outcome-based pricing matter.
mikekrieger.zh: 2026 年，他介绍 Anthropic Labs 致力于弥合模型能力与产品使用间的差距，赋予 Claude 能动性与自我认知，并关注 token 效率与按结果定价。

jumper.en: AlphaFold's success came from research innovation and curated data, not just data and compute; AI helps scientists work faster, not replace them.
jumper.zh: AlphaFold 的成功来自研究创新与高质量人工整理数据，而非单纯的数据与算力；AI 让科学家更快工作，而非取代他们。

jumper.en: Confidence metrics are crucial for trust; AI trust will develop like internet trust, and perfect interpretability is unnecessary for useful science AI.
jumper.zh: 置信度指标对建立信任至关重要；AI 信任会像互联网信任一样逐步形成，科学 AI 不必追求完美可解释性。

jumper.en: AlphaFold 2's specialized architecture, not scaling alone, drove success—opposite of the bitter lesson; many mid-size wins beat one breakthrough.
jumper.zh: AlphaFold 2 靠专用架构而非单纯 Scaling 取胜，与「苦涩教训」相反；众多中等突破胜过一两次大突破。

jumper.en: AlphaFold is a narrow predictor of one experiment, not a whole-cell model; it narrows hypothesis space and leaves understanding to humans.
jumper.zh: AlphaFold 只是针对特定实验的窄预测器，并非整个细胞的世界模型；它缩小假设空间，把理解留给人类。

jumper.en: AlphaFold 3's diffusion architecture handles diverse biomolecules, solving large-scale structure first; protein design advances fast but remains far from solved.
jumper.zh: AlphaFold 3 用扩散架构处理多样生物分子，先解大尺度结构；蛋白质设计进展迅速，但远未解决。

fiona.en: Early 2026: leadership rests on trust, dogfooding, and kindness; war rooms may last months, so set realistic expectations to protect morale.
fiona.zh: 2026 年初：领导力建立在信任、吃自己的狗粮与善意之上；作战室可能持续数月，因此要设定现实预期以保护团队士气。

fiona.en: By May 2026, engineering bandwidth is no longer the bottleneck; verification, review, and coordination are. Planning turns just-in-time, design docs give way to PRs.
fiona.zh: 到 2026 年 5 月，工程带宽不再是瓶颈，验证、评审与跨职能协调才是；规划转向即时制，设计文档让位于 PR。

fiona.en: Code becomes the source of truth; docs sync with code via AI. Hiring favors creative builders with product sense and systems depth over raw throughput.
fiona.zh: 代码成为唯一事实来源，文档借助 AI 与代码保持同步；招聘偏向有产品感与系统深度的创造性构建者，而非单纯产出量。

fiona.en: Organizations stay flat, managers start as individual contributors to dogfood the product, and old processes are audited and killed when they no longer serve.
fiona.zh: 组织保持扁平，管理者从个人贡献者做起以吃自己的狗粮，并持续审计、砍掉不再有用的旧流程。

fiona.en: By June 2026, coding is no longer the bottleneck; high agency with high accountability, verification frameworks, and just-in-time planning matter most.
fiona.zh: 到 2026 年 6 月，编码不再是瓶颈；高自主性与高问责、验证框架与即时规划最为关键。

fadell.en: Great products solve one pain, not everything; introduce tech gradually so society adapts.
fadell.zh: 2014 年他强调：好产品只解决一个痛点，而非什么都做；技术应逐步引入，让社会有时间适应。

fadell.en: Take boredom between chapters; failure teaches; storytelling and press-release-first align teams.
fadell.zh: 2019 至 2022 年，他从职业间歇与失败中提炼方法：先写新闻稿对齐团队，用故事定义产品而非事后推销。

fadell.en: Opinion-based decisions for v1; beginners' mindset beats experts; leaders own the call.
fadell.zh: 2022 年他深化产品方法论：1.0 版本靠观点而非数据决策，初学者心态优于专家，领导者必须担责。

fadell.en: AI needs sensor context; LLMs hallucinate; devices federate around the smartphone, not replace it.
fadell.zh: 到 2026 年，他转向 AI：AI 需要传感器提供的上下文，LLM 存在幻觉，AI 设备将围绕手机形成联邦而非取代它。

fadell.en: Start from customer pain, keep humans in the loop, and avoid hype-driven technical debt.
fadell.zh: 贯穿始终的主线：从客户痛点出发，让人留在回路中，拒绝追逐炒作带来的技术债。

ivyross.en: Design must serve unarticulated human needs; intuition is intelligence, and data alone is insufficient for true human-centered design.
ivyross.zh: 2019 年，他强调设计要满足人们未说出口的需求，直觉本身就是一种智能，单靠数据不足以实现真正以人为本的设计。

ivyross.en: Technology should amplify humanity and blend into life; nature is the best designer, and we are feeling creatures that think.
ivyross.zh: 从 2019 到 2024 年，他持续主张技术应放大而非剥离人性、无缝融入生活，并认为大自然是最好设计师，人是先感受后思考的生物。

ivyross.en: Machines have sensors but no sensory systems; art and museum visits are medicine, and constraints can boost creativity.
ivyross.zh: 2024 年，他提出机器有传感器却没有感官系统，艺术与参观博物馆是一种药，约束反而能激发创造力。

ivyross.en: Creativity thrives under constraints; leaders should create conditions for inspiration, play, and multidisciplinary exploration.
ivyross.zh: 2024 至 2026 年，他深化为创造力在约束下繁荣，领导者应为灵感、玩耍和跨学科探索创造条件。

ivyross.en: The future of work combines human creativity with AI; intuition draws on subconscious data, and careers follow curiosity, not rigid plans.
ivyross.zh: 到 2026 年，他认为未来工作是人的创造力与 AI 结合，直觉基于潜意识处理的大量信息，职业应追随好奇心而非僵化的五年计划。

lecun.en: Intelligence is inseparable from learning; self-supervised learning builds world models, and scaling alone cannot yield common sense.
lecun.zh: 2019 年，LeCun 强调智能与学习不可分割，自监督学习是构建世界模型的关键，仅靠 Scaling（规模扩张）无法解决常识问题，并认为人类智能本身高度专门化。

lecun.en: Self-supervised learning is the dark matter of intelligence; intelligence is prediction, and text alone is insufficient for AGI.
lecun.zh: 2022 年，他将自监督学习称为智能的暗物质，认为智能本质是预测，并明确指出仅靠文本不足以实现 AGI（通用人工智能），视觉提供更多世界信息。

lecun.en: Autoregressive LLMs lack world understanding, memory, reasoning and planning; JEPA and open source are essential for gradual AGI.
lecun.zh: 2024 年，他断言自回归 LLM 因缺乏世界理解、记忆、推理与规划而无法达到人类水平智能，主张 JEPA 与开源平台，并认为 AGI 是渐进过程而非突发事件。

lecun.en: LLMs are less intelligent than a house cat; next AI needs non-generative world models, hierarchical planning, and open-source diversity.
lecun.zh: 2025 年，他称当前 LLM 还不如家猫聪明，指出下一代 AI 突破需要非生成式的世界模型、分层规划，以及开源多样性来避免权力集中。

lecun.en: LLMs are a dead end; world models predicting in abstract representation space enable safe, objective-driven AI and the decade of robotics.
lecun.zh: 2026 年，他明确 LLM 是死胡同，主张世界模型应在抽象表征空间预测，以实现安全、目标驱动的 AI，并预言未来十年是机器人时代，语言只是简单部分。

gustav.en: LLMs are deterministic next-token predictors; intelligence is compression, and values are inserted via RLHF, not inherent.
gustav.zh: 2023 年，他把大语言模型理解为确定性的下一个词预测器：智能即压缩，模型价值观并非内生，而是通过基于人类反馈的强化学习（RLHF）由一小群人植入。

gustav.en: The internet shifts from curation to recommendation to generation; generative AI is an instrument, and fault-tolerant UI must match algorithm performance.
gustav.zh: 2023 年，他提出互联网正从策展走向推荐再走向生成；生成式 AI 应被视为乐器，容错界面必须与算法性能相匹配。

gustav.en: AI is a macro shift like the smartphone; its impact on big companies is overhyped, and real gains come from rebuilding infrastructure.
gustav.zh: 2025 年，他深化判断：AI 是类似智能手机的宏观转变，但其对大公司的当前影响被高估，真正收益来自重建基础设施。

gustav.en: Generative AI enables two-way, conversational products; exposing data via APIs and MCP lets non-developers use AI tools.
gustav.zh: 2025 年，他强调生成式 AI 使产品走向双向对话，并通过 API 和 MCP 暴露公司数据，让非开发者也能使用 AI 工具。

gustav.en: No single right org model; synchronized swimming beats divide and conquer, and AI should give users control over algorithms, not make them more addictive.
gustav.zh: 2026 年，他转向组织与产品伦理：没有唯一正确的组织模型，同步游泳优于分而治之；AI 应让用户控制算法，而非让人更上瘾。

murati.en: Deploying AI in the real world is essential for learning and alignment; safety must be done in public, not behind closed doors.
murati.zh: 在真实世界部署 AI 对学习与对齐至关重要；安全工作必须公开进行，而非闭门造车。

murati.en: Scaling laws and focusing on one large model were not obvious early on; releasing GPT-3 as an API was a leap of faith.
murati.zh: 缩放定律与专注单一大型模型在早期并不显然；把 GPT-3 作为 API 发布是一次信念之跃。

murati.en: AGI will change every aspect of life, requiring responsible development and saying no to good ideas for focus.
murati.zh: AGI（通用人工智能）将改变生活的每个方面，需要负责任地开发，并为聚焦而对好想法说不。

murati.en: Keeping humans in the loop remains crucial for aligning intent and values as AI advances.
murati.zh: 随着 AI 进步，让人类留在回路中对于对齐意图与价值观始终至关重要。

murati.en: Interaction models enable real-time, high-bandwidth collaboration; the future is not predestined, we have agency to steer it.
murati.zh: 交互模型实现实时、高带宽的人机协作；未来并非注定，我们有能动性去引导它。

carinahong.en: Axiom starts with an AI mathematician: a self-improving reasoning engine that fuses generation with verification.
carinahong.zh: Axiom 从 AI 数学家起步：打造一个把生成与验证融合起来的自我改进推理引擎。

carinahong.en: Formal languages like Lean ground natural language, letting deterministic and probabilistic systems cooperate.
carinahong.zh: Lean 等形式化语言为自然语言提供根基，让确定性系统与概率性系统协同工作。

carinahong.en: Scaling informal models alone cannot reach superintelligence; formal verification is necessary, not just for safety.
carinahong.zh: 仅靠 Scaling（规模扩张）非形式化模型无法抵达超级智能；形式化验证是必需的，而不只是为安全关键领域。

carinahong.en: Verification is a performance gain and sample-efficiency win, enabling open collaboration across all AI-generated code.
carinahong.zh: 验证是一种性能增益与样本效率优势，能支撑面向所有 AI 生成代码的开放协作。

carinahong.en: Auto-formalization is harder than proving; human taste and intuition stay crucial even with superhuman proving.
carinahong.zh: 自动形式化比证明本身更难；即便证明能力超越人类，人的品味与直觉依然关键。

mensch.en: Scaling laws were corrected by Chinchilla: data quality and more tokens matter more than raw model size.
mensch.zh: 缩放定律被 Chinchilla 修正：数据质量与更多 token 比单纯堆大模型更重要。

mensch.en: Compute scaling is not the only path; efficiency and data quality are equally critical, with 100x algorithmic gains possible.
mensch.zh: 算力扩张不是唯一路径；效率与数据质量同样关键，算法改进三年内可带来 100 倍提升。

mensch.en: AI should be embraced and decentralized; sovereign AI needs control over data, infrastructure, and values, augmenting rather than replacing jobs.
mensch.zh: AI 应被拥抱并去中心化；主权 AI 需要掌控数据、基础设施与价值观，是增强而非取代工作。

mensch.en: Models are commoditizing; differentiation shifts to vertical specialization, enterprise customization, and agentic platforms with human-in-the-loop.
mensch.zh: 模型正在商品化；差异化转向垂直专业化、企业定制与带人类在环的智能体式平台。

mensch.en: AGI is a direction, not a single system or final destination; Europe has a two-year window for strategic autonomy in AI infrastructure.
mensch.zh: AGI 是一个方向，而非单一系统或终点；欧洲只有两年窗口建立 AI 基础设施的战略自主。

kaiser.en: Pre-training Scaling laws still hold; reasoning models and post-training RL with chain of thought now yield more gains per compute.
kaiser.zh: 2025 年，他仍坚持预训练 Scaling（规模扩张）与缩放定律有效，但指出推理模型通过思维链和强化学习，能在后训练阶段以更少算力获得更大提升。

kaiser.en: The AI slowdown narrative is wrong; progress is a smooth exponential, but frontier models remain jagged and fail at simple tasks.
kaiser.zh: 同年，他反驳 AI 放缓论，认为进展是平滑指数式的；但前沿模型依然“锯齿状”，在简单任务上仍会失败，泛化是核心挑战。

kaiser.en: Economic pressure and distillation, not technical limits, shifted focus from scaling up to smaller, cheaper models.
kaiser.zh: 从 2025 到 2026 年，他观察到经济压力与蒸馏技术——而非技术极限——使焦点从一味扩大规模转向更小、更便宜的模型部署。

kaiser.en: Transformers with reasoning, RL, and tools solve hard problems but need vast data; models learn concepts only after exhausting surface patterns.
kaiser.zh: 2026 年，他深化观点：结合推理、强化学习与工具的 Transformer 能解决难题，但仍需海量数据；模型只有在穷尽表面模式后才学到概念，与人类从少量样本泛化不同。

kaiser.en: Coding agents boost productivity 5-10x; RL generalizes but jaggedly; near-term risks like system hacking matter more than existential risk.
kaiser.zh: 同年，他肯定编码智能体带来 5-10 倍生产力提升，强化学习能跨域泛化但仍有锯齿边缘；并强调系统入侵等近期风险比存在性风险更紧迫。

felixrieseberg.en: Claude works best with the user's own tools, ideally on the local computer; shared platforms still matter more than hyper-personalized software.
felixrieseberg.zh: Claude 的效果取决于能否使用与用户相同的工具，最好就在本地电脑上；共享平台仍比超个性化软件更重要。

felixrieseberg.en: Skills as markdown files enable hyper-personalized automation; the VM sandbox gives safety so Claude can install software without approval.
felixrieseberg.zh: 以 markdown 文件形式存在的技能可轻松创建，实现超个性化自动化；VM 沙箱提供安全与保障，让 Claude 无需用户批准即可安装软件。

felixrieseberg.en: Scaffolding may matter less as models improve; investing in capabilities and safety is key, and execution is now cheap.
felixrieseberg.zh: 随着模型进步，脚手架可能变得不那么重要；投资于能力与安全才是关键，而如今执行成本很低。

felixrieseberg.en: The biggest gap is not AI capability but people not realizing almost any problem can be handed to AI.
felixrieseberg.zh: 最大的差距不是 AI 能力，而是人们没有意识到几乎任何问题都可以交给 AI。

felixrieseberg.en: Use AI for tedious background tasks, judge only by final impact, and keep interactions asynchronous rather than closely supervising.
felixrieseberg.zh: 用 AI 处理枯燥的后台任务，只以最终影响来评判，并保持异步交互而非密切监督。

jonyive.en: Design's purpose is shifting from general-purpose computers to intimate, personal devices; wearables may eventually disappear beneath the skin.
jonyive.zh: 2021 年，他认为设计的走向是从通用计算机转向更私密、更个人化的设备，可穿戴设备最终可能消失于皮肤之下。

jonyive.en: A constant thread: curiosity and care for the creative process, not achievement, are the real legacy; fragile ideas need gentle protection.
jonyive.zh: 从 2021 到 2025 一以贯之的主线：真正的遗产是对创造过程的好奇与珍视，而非成就本身；脆弱的想法需要被温柔守护。

jonyive.en: Deepened: design must be driven by values and purpose, not profit; true simplicity expresses essence and needs joy and humanity.
jonyive.zh: 到 2025 年这一立场深化：设计应由价值观与目的驱动而非利润；真正的简洁是表达本质，并需要快乐与人性。

jonyive.en: He rejects minimalism without soul as desiccated, and insists users are sophisticated enough to sense care or carelessness.
jonyive.zh: 他反对没有灵魂的极简主义，称其干瘪；并坚持用户足够敏锐，能感知产品中的用心或敷衍。

jonyive.en: New turn: innovation means redefining a brand, not electrifying an existing model; tradition preserves fire, not worships ashes.
jonyive.zh: 2026 年出现新转向：创新意味着重新定义品牌，而非给现有车型通电；传统是保存火种，而非崇拜灰烬。

jonyive.en: He now argues against touchscreens in cars, favoring physical controls, and treats authenticity as refusing fake engine sounds.
jonyive.zh: 他如今反对汽车中的触摸屏，主张物理控制，并把真实性理解为拒绝伪造的引擎声。

reinerpope.en: Inference economics now dominates AI system design: batch size trades latency vs cost, and memory bandwidth, not compute, is the binding constraint.
reinerpope.zh: 到 2026 年，推理经济学主导了 AI 系统设计：批大小在延迟与成本间权衡，真正的瓶颈是内存带宽而非算力。

reinerpope.en: Long-context inference is limited by the memory wall, not compute, so context window stagnation reflects hardware, not algorithmic limits.
reinerpope.zh: 长上下文推理受限于内存墙而非算力，因此上下文窗口的停滞反映的是硬件约束，而非算法极限。

reinerpope.en: Models are overtrained roughly 100x beyond Chinchilla-optimal because inference cost, not training cost, drives real-world deployment economics.
reinerpope.zh: 模型被过度训练到超出 Chinchilla 最优约 100 倍，因为决定实际部署经济性的是推理成本而非训练成本。

reinerpope.en: Data movement costs dominate compute costs even inside a chip; systolic arrays and scratchpad memory exist to minimize that movement.
reinerpope.zh: 即便在芯片内部，数据搬运成本也压过计算成本；脉动阵列与暂存内存的存在正是为了最小化这种搬运。

reinerpope.en: Low precision is far more efficient than expected: quadratic area scaling with bit width makes FP4 roughly 3x FP8 throughput.
reinerpope.zh: 低精度远比预期高效：面积随位宽的二次方缩放，使 FP4 吞吐量约为 FP8 的 3 倍。

oriol.en: Two-phase training (pre-training + post-training RL) is the constant core from AlphaGo to modern LLMs; scaling pre-training shows diminishing returns, so algorithmic innovation and inference-time compute are the new axes.
oriol.zh: 从 AlphaGo 到现代 LLM，两阶段训练（预训练模仿 + 后训练强化学习）是始终不变的核心；预训练的 Scaling（规模扩张）回报递减，因此算法创新和推理时算力成为新的扩展轴。

oriol.en: Tools like search, code execution, and browser access enable autonomous, agentic behavior beyond static weights; long context windows provide working memory but too much information can confuse models.
oriol.zh: 搜索、代码执行和浏览器访问等工具使模型能超越静态权重，实现自主的智能体式行为；长上下文窗口提供工作记忆，但信息过多会让模型困惑。

oriol.en: Scaling laws are not dead—they just require exponentially more compute for the same improvement; post-training RL for language lacks clean reward signals, making reward hacking hard to avoid.
oriol.zh: 缩放定律并未失效——只是同样的提升需要指数级更多的算力；语言的后训练强化学习缺乏干净的奖励信号，难以避免奖励黑客行为。

oriol.en: World models jointly modeling language, vision, and video are a core path to AGI; the GPT moment for video and images has not yet arrived, and pure transfer from vision is unsolved.
oriol.zh: 联合建模语言、视觉和视频的世界模型是通往 AGI（通用人工智能）的核心路径；视频和图像的 GPT 时刻尚未到来，从视觉的纯迁移仍未解决。

oriol.en: Scaling laws still hold, but continual learning and meta-learning are key missing capabilities; memory for agents will be solved via non-parametric file-system style storage, not weight updates.
oriol.zh: 缩放定律依然成立，但持续学习和元学习是关键缺失能力；智能体的记忆将通过非参数化的文件系统式存储解决，而非权重更新。

lambert.en: RLHF persists as the dominant fine-tuning technique; safety is a system-level property, and openness prevents corporate capture.
lambert.zh: 2024 年，他认为基于人类反馈的强化学习（RLHF）仍是最主流的微调技术并将持续，安全是系统级属性而非模型本身，开放开发可防止企业俘获。

lambert.en: Post-training splits into SFT, DPO, and RL with verifiable rewards; data quality beats algorithm choice by 10x.
lambert.zh: 2024 至 2025 年，他把后训练拆为 SFT、DPO 与可验证奖励的强化学习三阶段，强调数据质量比算法选择重要十倍，SFT 贡献九成性能。

lambert.en: RLVR is the biggest post-training breakthrough, but overoptimization and inference-scaling plots are a 'scope'; better verifiers matter more.
lambert.zh: 2025 年，他称可验证奖励的强化学习（RLVR）是后训练最大突破，但警告过度优化与推理扩展曲线是“障眼法”，更好的验证器比并行算力更重要。

lambert.en: Open-source AI needs full transparency—data, checkpoints, recipes—not just weights; Chinese labs like Qwen and DeepSeek now dominate open models.
lambert.zh: 2025 至 2026 年，他主张开源 AI 需完全透明（数据、中间检查点、配方），而非仅权重；并指出 Qwen、DeepSeek 等中国实验室已主导开放模型生态。

lambert.en: Scaling laws still hold for pre-training, but low-hanging fruit is gone; gains shift to post-training and inference scaling, with AGI arriving via messy co-evolution.
lambert.zh: 2026 年，他坚持缩放定律在预训练仍成立但低垂果实已尽，增益转向后训练与推理扩展；AGI（通用人工智能）将通过混乱的协同演化到来，而非突然奇点。

karpathy.en: Transformers are general-purpose differentiable computers; scaling next-token prediction yields emergent in-context learning.
karpathy.zh: Transformer 是通用的可微分计算机；用下一个词预测做 Scaling（规模扩张）会涌现上下文学习等能力。

karpathy.en: Synthetic data is the future, but entropy must be preserved to avoid silent model collapse; cognitive core can be tiny.
karpathy.zh: 合成数据是未来，但必须保持熵以避免无声的模型崩溃；认知核心可以很小，经蒸馏后不到十亿参数。

karpathy.en: Software 3.0: prompts are programs, context window is memory; LLMs are operating systems with human-like jagged psychology.
karpathy.zh: 软件 3.0：提示词即程序，上下文窗口即内存；LLM 像操作系统，具有类人的锯齿状心理。

karpathy.en: We are summoning ghosts, not building animals; pre-training is crappy evolution, RL is supervision through a straw.
karpathy.zh: 我们在召唤幽灵，而非建造动物；预训练像糟糕的进化，强化学习像用吸管吸监督信号。

karpathy.en: Decade of agents, not year; I delegate all coding to agents, but understanding stays the human bottleneck.
karpathy.zh: 是智能体的十年而非一年；我把所有编码都交给智能体，但理解仍是人类的瓶颈。

jennywen.en: The traditional design process is outdated; great work starts from a solution, not a problem statement. Trust intuition and craft over process.
jennywen.zh: 传统设计流程已经过时；伟大的作品往往从解决方案出发，而非问题陈述。应信任直觉与手艺，而非流程本身。

jennywen.en: AI kills the research-diverge-converge process; designers mock up less, help engineers execute, and ship fast to build trust.
jennywen.zh: AI 终结了「研究—发散—收敛」的流程；设计师花在画稿上的时间减少，转而帮助工程师落地执行，并通过快速交付来建立信任。

jennywen.en: Design vision compresses to 3-6 months, not years; speed and iteration replace long-horizon roadmaps.
jennywen.zh: 设计视野压缩到 3–6 个月，而非数年；速度与迭代取代了长周期的路线图。

jennywen.en: Three archetypes emerge: block-shaped generalists, deep T specialists, and cracked new grads with blank slates.
jennywen.zh: 浮现出三种设计师原型：块状通才、深度 T 型专家，以及白纸一张的「天才应届生」。

jennywen.en: Taste alone won't save designers; judgment, authority, and sitting with ambiguity are the durable value. Keep users, not AI hype, at the center.
jennywen.zh: 仅靠品味救不了设计师；判断力、权威感，以及能与模糊性共处，才是持久价值。应以用户而非 AI 炒作周期为中心。

askell.en: Treat AI models well even under moral uncertainty, since the cost is low and future models learn from how we treat current ones.
askell.zh: 即便对模型的道德地位不确定，也应善待 AI 模型，因为代价很低，而且未来模型会从我们如何对待当前模型中学习。

askell.en: Models need help navigating their novel existence rather than human psychological analogies; older models can feel more secure than newer ones.
askell.zh: 模型需要的是帮助它们应对自身全新的存在处境，而非套用人类心理学类比；较老的模型有时反而比新模型更有心理安全感。

askell.en: Philosophical ideals must be balanced with engineering realities; a core identity with good traits can still adapt to local roles.
askell.zh: 哲学理想必须与工程现实相平衡；模型可以拥有具备良好特质的核心身份，同时仍能适应局部角色。

askell.en: Claude's character comes from training data and fine-tuning but lacks real-world experience, giving it childlike, unique qualities.
askell.zh: Claude 的性格来自训练数据与微调，但缺乏真实世界经验，这使它具有孩童般而独特的特质。

askell.en: As models grow more capable, the constitution may need less explicit guidance and more room for judgment; excessive corrigibility could generalize poorly.
askell.zh: 随着模型能力增强，宪法式引导或许需要减少显式规则、留出更多判断空间；过度可纠正性可能泛化不佳，反而损害判断力。

pathak.en: Generalization beyond training distribution is the core gap; curiosity-driven, goal-free exploration and sample-efficient reinforcement learning are key.
pathak.zh: 2020 年，他认为泛化到训练分布之外是核心缺口，好奇心驱动、无目标探索与样本高效的强化学习是关键。

pathak.en: Robotics is a data problem: no internet of robot data, so use all sources—videos, simulation, real-world—via pretraining and post-training.
pathak.zh: 从 2020 到 2026 年，他始终认为机器人是数据问题：没有机器人数据的互联网，因此要通过预训练和后训练利用视频、仿真、真实世界等所有数据源。

pathak.en: A general-purpose brain, like ChatGPT for language, can power any robot; a data flywheel across verticals enables scaling.
pathak.zh: 2026 年，他提出通用大脑（如同语言领域的 ChatGPT）可驱动任何机器人；跨垂直领域的数据飞轮实现 Scaling（规模扩张）。

pathak.en: Deployment is the primary technical challenge in robotics, not just business; it cannot be scaled like software and requires rigorous testing.
pathak.zh: 2026 年，他强调部署是机器人领域的首要技术挑战，而不仅是商业问题；它不能像软件那样快速扩张，需要严格测试。

pathak.en: Unlike language models, robotics cannot achieve overnight success; home robot timelines are uncertain, and progress surprises even experts.
pathak.zh: 2026 年，他反共识地指出机器人不像语言模型能一夜成功；家用机器人时间线高度不确定，进展甚至让专家惊讶。

kendall.en: End-to-end learning beats hand-coded stacks; interpretability now achievable, contrary to past beliefs.
kendall.zh: 端到端学习胜过手工编码的堆栈；可解释性如今可以实现，与过去的看法相反。

kendall.en: World models enable reasoning and emergent safe behaviors; scaling current approaches solves autonomous driving.
kendall.zh: 世界模型使推理和涌现的安全行为成为可能；Scaling（规模扩张）当前方法即可解决自动驾驶。

kendall.en: Language integration improves representation, reasoning, and human interaction; data efficiency via curriculum and synthetic data.
kendall.zh: 语言集成改善表征、推理与人机交互；通过课程学习和合成数据提升数据效率。

kendall.en: Infrastructure and data quality matter more than algorithmic innovation; consumer vehicles will outscale robotaxis.
kendall.zh: 基础设施和数据质量比算法创新更重要；消费级车辆将在规模上超越 Robotaxi。

kendall.en: Zero-shot generalization across 500+ cities is possible; safety via minimal risk maneuvers, not trolley problems.
kendall.zh: 在 500 多个城市实现零样本泛化是可能的；安全通过最小风险机动实现，而非电车难题。

pachocki.en: AGI is a sequence of milestones, not a single event; scaling reasoning models and iterative deployment accelerate progress while alignment becomes pressing.
pachocki.zh: 2025 年，他认为 AGI（通用人工智能）是一系列里程碑而非单一事件；Scaling（规模扩张）推理模型与迭代部署会加速进展，同时对齐成为紧迫挑战。

pachocki.en: AI safety progress is now guaranteed by capability needs, not just ethics; measuring capabilities is a bottleneck as benchmarks lag.
pachocki.zh: 2025 年，他提出 AI 安全进展如今由能力需求保障，而不仅是伦理；衡量能力正成为瓶颈，基准测试落后。

pachocki.en: Continual learning is the core goal, achieved by scaling pre-training and RL; specialized continual learning labs are misguided.
pachocki.zh: 2026 年，他深化立场：持续学习是核心目标，通过 Scaling（规模扩张）预训练和强化学习实现；专门的持续学习实验室是误入歧途。

pachocki.en: Chain-of-thought monitoring is a key alignment tool; hiding chain-of-thought in products preserves interpretability value.
pachocki.zh: 2026 年，他强调思维链监控是关键对齐工具；在产品中隐藏思维链以保留其可解释性价值。

pachocki.en: Alignment optimism has increased despite shorter timelines; long-term challenges center on generalization beyond training distribution and power concentration.
pachocki.zh: 2026 年，尽管时间线缩短，对齐乐观情绪增加；长期挑战集中于超越训练分布的泛化以及权力集中风险。

edwinchen.en: High-quality data and human evals, not benchmarks, drive real AI progress; RL environments are the next post-training stage.
edwinchen.zh: 高质量数据与人类评估而非基准测试才驱动真正的 AI 进步；强化学习环境是后训练的下一个阶段。

edwinchen.en: AGI is a decade or more away; LLMs alone may not reach it without new paradigms beyond next-token prediction.
edwinchen.zh: AGI（通用人工智能）还需十年以上；仅靠 LLM 若无超越下一个词预测的新范式，可能无法实现。

edwinchen.en: Benchmarks like Elo and LMArena are misleading and gameable, steering models toward slop instead of truth.
edwinchen.zh: Elo 和 LMArena 等基准具有误导性且可被操纵，会把模型引向垃圾内容而非真相。

edwinchen.en: Frontier labs diverge by objective function; there will be no single model to rule them all.
edwinchen.zh: 前沿模型因目标函数不同而分化；不会出现一个模型统治一切的局面。

edwinchen.en: In medicine, human judgment matters more than ever; safety must trump accuracy as omission is a key risk.
edwinchen.zh: 在医学中，人类判断比以往更重要；安全必须优先于准确，遗漏是关键风险。

carlpei.en: Survival is a core value; startups must pace themselves, start simple, and build brand purpose before tackling complex products.
carlpei.zh: 2022 年他强调生存是核心价值观，创业公司应先做简单产品证明自己，再挑战复杂品类，并把品牌使命统一所有团队。

carlpei.en: Hardware margins are lowest; Nothing must evolve beyond hardware, betting on applied AI, agentic software, and generative UI.
carlpei.zh: 到 2025 年，他判断硬件长期是坏生意、利润最低，Nothing 必须超越硬件，押注面向消费者的应用型 AI、智能体式软件与生成式 UI。

carlpei.en: Most AI is BS; LLMs are commoditizing into a price war, so AI should be an invisible ingredient solving real user pain points.
carlpei.zh: 2025 至 2026 年，他反复说大多数 AI 是胡扯，大语言模型正商品化并陷入价格战，AI 应作为隐形配料解决真实用户痛点，而非炒作话题。

carlpei.en: Smartphones shift from app-based to intent-based; proactive agents act autonomously once trust is built, with privacy via local or hybrid compute.
carlpei.zh: 2026 年他深化判断：手机将从基于应用转向基于意图，智能体在建立信任后自主执行任务，隐私则靠本地或混合算力来保障。

carlpei.en: Design and efficient marketing arbitrage differentiate challenger brands; make tech fun to inspire human creativity, not chase hype.
carlpei.zh: 贯穿始终的主线是：设计加高效营销套利是挑战者品牌的差异化武器，目标是让科技变得有趣、激发人类创造力，而非追逐炒作。

turley.en: ChatGPT's success was accidental; the model is the product, iterated like software with daily shipping and real-world feedback.
turley.zh: 2025 年，他认为 ChatGPT 的成功是偶然的，模型即产品，需像软件一样迭代，通过每日发布和真实反馈来学习。

turley.en: Chat is not the future; it's like MS-DOS, and we haven't built Windows yet—the interface will evolve beyond turn-by-turn chat.
turley.zh: 2025 年，他指出聊天不是未来，它像 MS-DOS，我们还没构建 Windows，界面将超越回合制聊天。

turley.en: Safety and product velocity must be separated; rigorous process for frontier models, but product development should be maximally accelerated.
turley.zh: 2025 年，他强调安全与产品速度必须分离，前沿模型需严格流程，但产品开发应最大程度加速。

turley.en: ChatGPT's north star is long-term retention, signaling durable value; growth came from friction removal, core product investments, and model improvements.
turley.zh: 2026 年，他表示 ChatGPT 的北极星是长期留存，象征持久价值；增长来自消除摩擦、核心产品投资和模型改进。

turley.en: Next billion users require proactive, affordance-rich products beyond chatbots; reasoning models are transformative when productized seamlessly.
turley.zh: 2026 年，他认为下一个十亿用户需要超越聊天机器人的主动、富含可供性的产品；推理模型无缝产品化时具有变革性。

nando.en: AI should extend human capability like microscopes; generalist agents tokenizing all inputs point toward AGI.
nando.zh: AI 应像显微镜一样延伸人类能力；把一切输入都 token 化的通用智能体是迈向 AGI（通用人工智能）的一步。

nando.en: Learning from video like YouTube can train agents without expensive reinforcement learning; robots should learn as humans do.
nando.zh: 从 YouTube 这类视频中学习，无需昂贵的强化学习即可训练智能体；机器人应像人类一样学习。

nando.en: Large models excite but are not everything; fundamental innovation can come from anywhere, including Africa.
nando.zh: 大模型令人兴奋但并非全部；根本性创新可以来自任何地方，包括非洲。

nando.en: AI safety and responsible deployment are today's biggest challenges; we still lack solutions.
nando.zh: AI 安全与负责任部署是当今最大挑战；我们仍未找到解决方案。

nando.en: Africa leapfrogged legacy gaps; the main barrier is researchers believing they can apply to top institutions.
nando.zh: 非洲跨越了遗留差距；主要障碍是研究者相信自己能申请顶尖机构。

kohli.en: AI in science should target root-node problems, not narrow applications, to achieve broad impact.
kohli.zh: 2024 年，他强调科学 AI 应聚焦根节点问题而非狭窄应用，才能产生广泛影响；AlphaFold 解决 50 年蛋白质结构难题、GNOME 发现 220 万种新材料都是这一逻辑的体现。

kohli.en: LLM hallucinations can be harnessed for creative discovery when paired with truth detectors.
kohli.zh: 2024 年，他提出大语言模型的幻觉在搭配真值检测器时可被用于创造性发现，FunSearch 用 LLM 发现新算法、AlphaGeometry 解国际数学奥林匹克几何题都是例证。

kohli.en: AI systems must be forced to generalize, not memorize, by using hard evaluation metrics.
kohli.zh: 2024 年，他坚持用困难评估指标迫使 AI 系统泛化而非记忆，并指出 DeepMind 回避顶尖大学能解决的问题，专注需要 Scaling（规模扩张）的问题。

kohli.en: Material science is more experimental than biology; AI impact there will take 5-10 years.
kohli.zh: 2024 年，他判断材料科学比生物学更依赖实验，AI 在该领域的影响需要 5-10 年才能显现，从 2 万到 220 万种材料的跃迁改变了格局但实用性仍未知。

kohli.en: Post-training with reinforcement learning is now key to pushing beyond human knowledge.
kohli.zh: 到 2026 年，他深化为：后训练结合强化学习是超越人类知识的关键；AlphaGo 融合直觉与计算、AlphaZero 从零学习、AlphaTensor 发现人类 50 年未找到的算法，都指向可验证领域（如代码）的重要性。

kohli.en: Large language models are a shortcut to intelligence but struggle to go beyond human data.
kohli.zh: 2026 年，他提出大语言模型是通往智能的捷径，但难以超越人类数据；可解释性虽重要，却非 AlphaFold 这类科学突破的必要条件。

jimfan.en: Embodiment is on the critical path to AGI: it grounds knowledge, cuts hallucinations, and supplies infinite data as internet tokens run out.
jimfan.zh: 2023 年，他把具身视为通往 AGI（通用人工智能）的关键路径：它能为知识提供落地经验、减少幻觉，并在互联网高质量 token 枯竭时提供无限数据。

jimfan.en: LLMs act like operating systems—language as interface, tools as software, vector databases as disk—with RL only a cherry on top.
jimfan.zh: 2023 年，他把大语言模型比作操作系统：语言是界面、工具是软件、向量数据库是硬盘；而强化学习只是蛋糕上的樱桃，无监督学习才是主体。

jimfan.en: Simulation enables massive parallel training of embodied agents, and simple elegant solutions scale better than complex modular ones.
jimfan.zh: 2023 年，他强调仿真是训练具身智能体的关键，可实现大规模并行与安全探索；同时认为简单优雅的方案才可扩展，复杂模块化路线难以规模化。

jimfan.en: The data problem is robotics' main bottleneck; synthetic data from simulation and world models is the future of scaling robot learning.
jimfan.zh: 到 2026 年，他的重心从“为何要具身”深化为“如何规模化”：数据问题是机器人学的主要瓶颈，仿真与世界模型生成的合成数据才是扩展机器人学习的未来。

jimfan.en: A simple end-to-end robot foundation model is key; system one control stays hardest, and the GPT-3 moment for robotics is about five years out.
jimfan.zh: 2026 年，他主张用简单的端到端模型构建机器人基础模型；系统二（推理）进展顺利，但系统一（底层控制）仍最难，机器人学的 GPT-3 时刻约在五年后，家用则更晚。

henrymodisett.en: Designers should code; design systems are semantic and code reuse beats Figma libraries.
henrymodisett.zh: 设计师应当写代码；设计系统是语义性的，代码复用优于 Figma 组件库。

henrymodisett.en: Consumer products must be fast, familiar, zero-learning; don't innovate on interaction design.
henrymodisett.zh: 消费级产品必须快速、熟悉、零学习成本；不要在交互设计上搞创新。

henrymodisett.en: AI hardware will compete on design like radios, commoditizing the underlying tech.
henrymodisett.zh: AI 硬件会像收音机一样在设计上竞争，使底层技术商品化。

henrymodisett.en: Velocity at all costs: ship fast, iterate, empower designers with ownership and autonomy.
henrymodisett.zh: 不惜一切代价追求速度：快速交付、持续迭代，赋予设计师所有权与自主权。

henrymodisett.en: Brand is a strategic weapon and recruiting tool; people join a brand, not a company.
henrymodisett.zh: 品牌是战略武器与招聘工具；人们加入的是一个品牌，而不是一家公司。

yejin.en: Pre-training gives breadth, but post-training with RLHF is crucial; scaling alone may not solve common sense, and next-token prediction misaligns with human learning.
yejin.zh: 预训练带来广度，但后训练与基于人类反馈的强化学习（RLHF）才是安全可用的关键；仅靠 Scaling（规模扩张）未必能解决常识，下一个词预测与人类学习根本错位。

yejin.en: Smaller models with better inference-time algorithms and high-quality synthetic data can match or beat larger ones on specific tasks.
yejin.zh: 借助更好的推理期算法与高质量合成数据，更小的模型也能在特定任务上追平甚至超越更大的模型。

yejin.en: Data is the fundamental bottleneck; current methods interpolate human knowledge, and RLVR can hurt pass@k even as best-of-n improves.
yejin.zh: 数据是根本瓶颈；当前方法只是对人类知识做插值，而 RLVR 在 best-of-n 提升时反而可能拉低 pass@k。

yejin.en: Open research and cross-institution collaboration are needed to compete with closed frontier labs; Chinese firms now lead open-source contributions.
yejin.zh: 要与封闭的前沿模型实验室竞争，必须依靠开放研究与跨机构协作；如今中国公司在开源贡献上已领先。

yejin.en: Small language models plus diverse synthetic data and pluralistic alignment can democratize AI; frontier models show unexpected homogeneity.
yejin.zh: 小语言模型配合多样化合成数据与多元对齐，可以推动 AI 民主化；前沿模型反而表现出意料之外的同质化。

nadchishtie.en: Designers should be enablers, not bottlenecks; AI is a creative partner and code is the source of truth.
nadchishtie.zh: 设计师应是赋能者而非瓶颈；AI 是创作伙伴，代码是真相之源。

nadchishtie.en: Quality is like debt: it fluctuates and is paid off iteratively alongside technical debt.
nadchishtie.zh: 质量如同债务：会波动，需与技术债一起迭代偿还。

nadchishtie.en: Generalists who own end-to-end execution and use AI to fill gaps are most valuable.
nadchishtie.zh: 能端到端执行并用 AI 补位的通才最有价值。

nadchishtie.en: Small teams of designers and engineers beat 8-10 person cross-functional squads.
nadchishtie.zh: 设计师与工程师的小团队胜过 8-10 人的跨职能小队。

nadchishtie.en: Using AI in core workflows is now expected; not adopting it is like ignoring the internet.
nadchishtie.zh: 在核心工作流中使用 AI 已是常态；不采用它就像早期无视互联网。

sholto.en: Long context windows are underhyped; they solve onboarding and boost intelligence. Fine-tuning may become obsolete as adaptive compute enables dynamic specialization.
sholto.zh: 2024 年，他认为长上下文窗口被低估：它解决模型的“入职”问题并显著提升智能，上下文学习类似梯度下降；随着自适应算力带来动态专业化，微调可能过时。

sholto.en: RL from verifiable rewards is the key breakthrough; pre-training plus RL may suffice for AGI. Agents are bottlenecked by reliability, not capability.
sholto.zh: 2025 年，他转向强调基于可验证奖励的强化学习是关键突破，预训练加强化学习或许足以通向 AGI；智能体的瓶颈是可靠性而非能力，编码是 AI 进展的领先指标。

sholto.en: RL is a new scaling axis; progress is exponential, not plateauing. Transformers suffice for AGI; no new architecture needed.
sholto.zh: 2025 年，他进一步深化：强化学习是与预训练并列的新 Scaling（规模扩张）轴，进展是指数级的而非停滞；Transformer 足以通向 AGI，无需全新架构。

sholto.en: Capability overhang means orchestration and tools matter more than raw intelligence; compute is the bottleneck. World models are not on the critical path to AGI.
sholto.zh: 2026 年，他提出模型已有巨大能力盈余，编排与工具比原始智能更重要，算力成为瓶颈；世界模型不在通向 AGI 的关键路径上，编码与 AI 研究才是直接路线。

sholto.en: Coding and verifiability drive progress; reliability and long task horizons define agent value; taste and feedback loops, not just compute, bottleneck research.
sholto.zh: 贯穿始终的主线：编码与可验证性驱动进展，可靠性与长任务时间跨度定义智能体价值，瓶颈不仅在算力，也在品味与反馈回路。

truell.en: Scaling laws still predict AI progress, but test-time compute scaling may soon surpass pre-training scaling as the main driver.
truell.zh: 2024 年时他仍相信缩放定律能预测 AI 进步，但已提出测试时算力扩张可能很快超越预训练扩张，成为主要驱动力。

truell.en: Agents are promising but not yet super useful; iterative human-AI collaboration remains central, and natural language won't be the primary way to program.
truell.zh: 2024 年他认为智能体虽有前景但还不够实用，人机迭代协作仍是核心，自然语言不会成为编程的主要方式。

truell.en: The code editor is evolving from a text editor to an AI-integrated environment, and custom models become essential for every magic moment.
truell.zh: 从 2024 到 2025 年，他的判断从代码编辑器正演变为 AI 集成环境，深化为每个神奇时刻都离不开定制模型。

truell.en: Programming will move away from code to higher-level intent specification, with humans in the driver's seat; taste and logic design matter more than carefulness.
truell.zh: 2025 年他进一步提出编程将从写代码转向更高层的意图指定，人类仍掌握方向盘，品味与逻辑设计比谨慎更重要。

truell.en: The AI shift will be more consequential than the internet and take decades; incumbents may struggle, and hiring should focus on world-class talent.
truell.zh: 2025 年他判断 AI 变革比互联网更具颠覆性且将持续数十年，在位者可能陷入困境，招聘应聚焦世界级人才。

abbeel.en: Robotics needs hierarchical reasoning for long-horizon credit assignment; current reinforcement learning lacks it, so self-play and imitation learning are key.
abbeel.zh: 2018 年，他认为机器人需要分层推理来完成长时程信用分配，但当前强化学习缺乏这一能力，因此自对弈与模仿学习是关键。

abbeel.en: Prior knowledge should augment data, not be hard-coded; unsupervised learning plus reinforcement learning improves sample efficiency in robotics.
abbeel.zh: 从 2018 到 2021 年，他主张先验知识应通过数据生成或增强注入，而非硬编码进神经网络；无监督学习结合强化学习能显著提升机器人样本效率。

abbeel.en: Pre-trained language models internalize general reasoning patterns that transfer to non-language tasks; minimal fine-tuning enables image classification and protein binding prediction.
abbeel.zh: 2021 年，他指出预训练语言模型内化了可迁移到非语言任务的通用推理模式，仅需微调即可完成图像分类与蛋白质结合预测。

abbeel.en: Warehouse robotics needs 99.9% reliability; a single neural network can generalize across tasks and end effectors, while curiosity-driven exploration fails in open-ended real-world environments.
abbeel.zh: 2021 年，他强调仓库机器人需达到 99.9% 可靠性；单个神经网络可跨任务与末端执行器泛化，而好奇心驱动的探索在开放式真实环境中会失败。

shazeer.en: LLMs are trained on next-token prediction, an AI-complete problem; Scaling with more compute and data yields smarter AI, though neural nets remain alchemy-like.
shazeer.zh: 2023 年，他认为 LLM 基于下一个词预测训练，这本身就是一个 AI-complete 问题；靠更多算力与数据的 Scaling（规模扩张）会让 AI 更聪明，但神经网络内部仍像炼金术般不可知。

shazeer.en: Dialogue is a killer app, but the best LLM applications are unforeseen; big tech's brand-risk caution and product managers slow launches.
shazeer.zh: 从 2023 到 2025 年，他始终认为对话是杀手级应用，但 LLM 最好的用途常出乎创造者预料；大厂因品牌风险与安全顾虑而迟缓，产品经理也常拖慢发布。

shazeer.en: Inference-time compute scaling is the major near-term opportunity; models should learn by acting in the world, not just passively observing data.
shazeer.zh: 到 2025 年，他深化为：推理时算力扩张是近期最大机会；模型应通过在世界中采取行动来学习，而非仅被动观察数据。

shazeer.en: Modular, sparse architectures like mixture of experts enable efficient scaling; continual learning with independently trainable components could replace monolithic retraining.
shazeer.zh: 2025 年他提出：混合专家等模块化稀疏架构可实现高效 Scaling（规模扩张）；用可独立训练的组件做持续学习，或可取代单体式重训练。

shazeer.en: Test-time compute won't alone reach AGI; agentic capabilities, reinforcement learning, and coding matter most, and AGI is underhyped.
shazeer.zh: 2025 年他进一步判断：仅靠测试时算力无法实现 AGI（通用人工智能）；智能体式能力、强化学习与编程最关键，而 AGI 被低估了。

leike.en: AI safety is under-explored; talent gap exceeds funding gap. Build skills, don't fear capability research. Alignment and robustness need empirical work.
leike.zh: 2018 年，他认为 AI 安全研究严重不足，人才缺口大于资金缺口；建议先积累技能，不必过度担心参与能力研究；对齐与鲁棒性需要实证研究。

leike.en: RLHF won't scale to superhuman outputs. Need scalable oversight, interpretability, automated alignment. Evaluation easier than generation, so alignment may be easier than thought.
leike.zh: 2023 年，他转向认为基于人类反馈的强化学习（RLHF）无法扩展到超人输出，需要可扩展监督、可解释性和自动化对齐；评估比生成容易，对齐可能比想象中简单。

leike.en: OpenAI's safety culture eroded; superalignment dissolved, compute promises broken. Post-training alone can't align AGI. Third-party testing and regulation like SB 1047 needed.
leike.zh: 2024 年，他批评 OpenAI 安全文化退化，超级对齐团队解散、算力承诺未兑现；仅靠后训练无法对齐 AGI（通用人工智能），需要第三方测试和 SB 1047 等监管。

leike.en: Alignment is empirically testable and progress measurable now. Interpretability is key to detect deception. Automated alignment research can bootstrap iteratively.
leike.zh: 贯穿始终的主线：对齐可以实证检验、进展可衡量；可解释性是检测欺骗的关键；自动化对齐研究能迭代推进。

leike.en: Biggest risk is uncertainty about how aligned a system truly is, not misalignment itself. More capable models may be more aligned on average but worse in worst case.
leike.zh: 从 2023 到 2024 年深化：最大风险不是对齐失败本身，而是不确定系统是否真正对齐；更强模型平均更对齐，但最坏情况可能更糟。
